stories.description: A lapse in judgment led him to the world of Conan. When the detective solves cases, when the murderer kills, when the great thief steals things, it’s all just to eliminate that overwhelming crime value. A super famous detective, more so than Kogoro Mouri, a more terrifying murderer than Gin, a more mysterious thief than Phantom Thief Kid... However, in the eyes of the world, he is simply a student

chapterContents.content:
"Inspector Megure, I already know how the murderer killed President Tomizawa."

The hall instantly fell silent.

Feeling the strange looks around him, the man in the suit's face turned red as a tomato, and he lowered his head, wishing the earth would swallow him whole; this was a slap in the face.

"What? Really, young Hattori?" Inspector Megure approached with a pleasant surprise.

"Great!" A flash of joy crossed Kazuha's eyes, she didn't want her boyfriend to be looked down upon.

Sonoko sighed in relief, and a look of love shone in her pretty eyes.

"Great, Heiji didn't disappoint us, as expected," Ran said in a low voice.

[Hehe, that Ran, always worrying for nothing.]

Conan laughed to himself and rested his chin on his hand: President Tomizawa died of arsenic poisoning, but no reaction to poisons was detected, that's almost impossible. I think the same as Hattori, the murderer is one of the three triplets, but the method, what is the method?

He was about to go crazy, especially hearing that Heiji had figured out the method before him again, he couldn't accept it.

"Heiji, did you find the poison reaction?"

Miwako Sato came running. She had even analyzed the kitchen ingredients, and there was still no reaction.

Miwako Sato was speechless.

"I think you're just wasting time, let us go at once," Taichi Tomizawa said coldly.

"Don't be in a hurry, don't you want to know how your father died?" Heiji looked at Taichi Tomizawa indifferently.

Taichi Tomizawa was speechless and said no more.

Heiji approached the dining table, picked up a lobster, and addressing everyone, smiled confidently: "Lobster, especially this type of large, top-quality lobster, is a delicious seafood. However, prepared a certain way, it can carry a dissolved poison right under everyone's nose."

[What???]

Heiji's words hit like a thunderclap: Lobster can be used to deliver poison without obvious traces?

They had never thought of it.

[No, that's not what Hattori means — he means the lobster itself isn't poisonous, but the killer used the sauce or wine as a solvent to dissolve arsenic and hide it in the dish.]

Conan's pupils contracted sharply as he scanned the table and the empty plates; a cold realization crossed his face: Of course — the poison was dissolved into the sauce or wine so the usual spot tests missed it!

"Don't worry, lobster itself is not toxic; if handled properly there is no problem,"

Miwako Sato furrowed her pretty eyebrows and, looking at Heiji, said indifferently: "So what you mean is the lobster only became poisonous because something was added to it — something that carried the poison?"

"Exactly." Heiji nodded with satisfaction.

"I know — the wine or sauce was the carrier!" Takagi suddenly blurted out.

"Exactly. Someone dissolved arsenic into a liquid carrier — often a warm alcoholic sauce or fruit wine — and used it to bathe the lobster. Arsenic trioxide is tasteless and can be hard to detect in diluted food samples if it's dissolved and distributed across a dish. If the solution's acidity or composition is adjusted, it can mask the usual quick screening methods. That's why no immediate poison reaction showed up at first," Heiji said.

The entire hall fell into a deathly silence. Heiji's voice was not loud, but everyone heard it clearly.

Amazing!!!

Although this is something a chemist or an experienced poisoner might know, who normally thinks about these details? Wine, sauces and seafood are everyday items; who would suspect they could be used to conceal arsenic in a way that defeats quick tests?

"Analyze everything on the table immediately," Inspector Megure ordered.

Previously, they had assumed a straightforward poisoning and only ran standard poison screens; no one considered a deliberate carrier and masking technique.

Soon, the results of the analysis were ready.

"Inspector Megure, a large amount of citric acid and fruit concentrate has been detected in this bottle of mulberry wine." the lab officer announced.

"What?" Inspector Megure ran over, took the bottle of mulberry wine and looked seriously at the three triplets: "Whose bottle is this?"

"It's mine, but I don't know why it has so much fruit concentrate," shouted Tatsuji Tomizawa.

"Hmph, you planned this from the start — you deliberately bought this kind of fruit wine because its composition makes it an effective solvent for dissolving certain compounds. By combining it with lobster, you could spread a dissolved poison through the food and avoid immediate detection. Is that so, young Hattori?" Inspector Megure said, looking to Heiji for confirmation.

Heiji shook his head, and Inspector Megure was surprised.

"Mulberries do contain natural acids and vitamin C, but not in the quantity the lab detected. This much fruit concentrate indicates tampering — someone added a strong acidic extract or concentrate to the wine to adjust its solvent properties," Heiji explained.

"Mr. Heiji is right, the high level of fruit concentrate must have been added artificially," the lab officer confirmed.

"Oh." Inspector Megure felt deflated…

"However, it could still be assumed that Mr. Tatsuji added it," Miwako Sato said calmly.

"Yes, that possibility cannot be ruled out. That way, if discovered, he could claim it was an accidental flavoring," Heiji added.

"It's not true, it wasn't me, I didn't add anything to the wine!" Tatsuji Tomizawa protested nervously.

"Tatsuji, I can't imagine you being so cruel — he was our father! I know you're seeing someone Dad disapproved of, but you can't kill Dad just because he limited your money, right?" Taichi cried.

"Is what Mr. Taichi says true?" Inspector Megure asked Tatsuji seriously. "That could be a motive."

"It wasn't me! And if motive matters, my older brother Taichi and my younger brother Yuzo both have motives too," Tatsuji shouted.

"What?" Inspector Megure turned to the other two with a puzzled look.

"My older brother Taichi, since he likes to write novels and has no steady income, often asked Dad for money. But Dad insisted Taichi should inherit the business, so they argued constantly. You must have resented Dad a lot, right?" Tatsuji said.

Taichi Tomizawa froze, nodded, then hastily waved his hands. "But I didn't kill our father — at that time I didn't touch that bottle of wine."

Inspector Megure nodded and looked at Yuzo Tomizawa: "And you, Mr. Yuzo?"

"The same for Yuzo. He loves painting, but Dad always criticized him and forbade him from pursuing art. He resented him too," came the reply.

To deflect suspicion, Tatsuji spilled family secrets about Taichi and Yuzo.

"Did you keep the wine bottle the whole time?" Inspector Megure asked.

"No — I left it at Dad's house first. There was one night when it was unattended, and at that time both my older and younger brothers were home," Tatsuji answered.

Inspector Megure stroked his chin. "If no one watched it for a night, anyone could have tampered with it. That makes the two of you suspects as well."

"Young Hattori, what do you think?" Megure suddenly asked, turning to Heiji.

Heiji, standing to the side, smiled confidently: "Inspector Megure, do you really think the killer relied only on an obvious, easily-detected poison? Or would they use a carrier — something that can dissolve and spread the arsenic while hiding it from simple tests?"

Soon, Inspector Megure stormed into the hall, flanked by Officer Sato and her team.

"Hattori-kun, what happened here?" Inspector Megure asked immediately.

"Inspector Megure. There's been a murder. The President of the Tomizawa Group, Tetsuharu Tomizawa, has died from poisoning."

"What?" Inspector Megure's expression darkened. "Sato, cordon off the scene immediately!"

Officer Sato and Officer Takagi quickly organized their subordinates to secure the mansion, ensuring no one could enter or leave.

"Inspector, please hurry. We have to prepare for our father's funeral," Taichi Tomizawa said, his tone laced with impatience and discontent.

"Mr. Taichi, you seem in quite a hurry to leave. Do you not care about the truth? Or is it that you already know it?" Heiji remarked indifferently.

"Mr. Hattori, that is slander! Since you are so certain my father was poisoned, tell me: who is the murderer? And when was he poisoned?" Taichi countered with a hostile glare.

Heiji ignored him and approached Tetsuharu Tomizawa's corpse.

"Heiji, take these."

Kazuha walked over and handed him a pair of latex gloves.

"Well now, Hattori-kun, it seems Miss Kazuha has practically become your assistant," Inspector Megure commented with a slight smile.

"Inspector Megure is joking. I can only help Heiji with small things," Kazuha replied with practiced ease, acting naturally.

Heiji checked the pulse at Tetsuharu Tomizawa's carotid artery, then gently moved the victim's arm. A rough conclusion had already formed in his mind.

"The onset of symptoms was instant, and the body stiffened rapidly. This indicates a severe, fast-acting poison with a massive dosage. There was practically no latency period. And the only people who have been by his side this entire time, without stepping away, are you—the three brothers."

Heiji stood up and pointed at the triplets, his tone firm and resonant.

The guests stared at Heiji, dumbfounded. Tetsuharu Tomizawa was their father. Was the detective accusing one of the sons of parricide?

"Hattori-kun, how is that possible? He is their father," Inspector Megure said in disbelief.

"Inspector, sometimes you don't need a logical reason to kill," Heiji stated coldly.

"Bastard! You're slandering us! Why would we kill our own father?" Yuzo Tomizawa shouted.

"I'm just analyzing the facts. Inspector Megure, please have forensics examine the body."

Inspector Megure nodded seriously and instructed the forensics team to proceed.

"In the meantime, while we wait for the results, it would be best if you three do not leave the immediate vicinity of the crime scene to avoid unnecessary suspicion."

Heiji turned and walked toward the dining table.

"Kid, this isn't a playground. Get back."

An officer stopped Conan, blocking him from approaching the table.

"Let me go! I'm Big Brother Heiji's assistant! Let me go!"

Conan struggled, internally annoyed. That guy Hattori gets to have all the fun. I want to investigate too!

Suddenly, he missed Kogoro Mouri a little. At least with the old man around, he could usually sneak onto the crime scene freely instead of watching helplessly from the sidelines.

Heiji surveyed the dining table.

At Tetsuharu Tomizawa's seat, there wasn't much: a glass of mulberry wine, a bottle of heart medication, and a bowl containing several pieces of lobster meat.

To his right, at Taichi Tomizawa's spot, lay a pile of lobster shells and a large bowl of dipping sauce.

To his left sat Tatsuji Tomizawa, whose place setting only held a bottle of mulberry wine.

And next to him was Yuzo Tomizawa, whose table was bare except for the basic utensils.

Heiji picked up the victim's glass of mulberry wine and sniffed it. It carried a strong, fruity aroma.

"Heiji... can I call you Heiji?"

While he was searching for clues, Officer Sato's voice suddenly sounded beside him.

"Sure, whatever you like," Heiji nodded, focused on the glass.

"Heiji, have you found any clues?"

Sato had already ordered preliminary tests on the items on the table, but no reaction to common poisons had been detected on any of them.

"No."

Heiji shook his head. He would have to wait for the detailed toxicology report to verify his specific suspicions.

He returned to Kazuha's side. Sonoko immediately approached him, her eyes brimming with tears and fear. "Heiji... Uncle Tomizawa's death isn't our responsibility, is it?"

Heiji sighed, his expression softening. "Don't worry. I'll help you prove that this has nothing to do with the Suzuki Group."

Sonoko nodded slightly and stood silently to the side. No one would feel good about a murder occurring at their own birthday party. Kazuha and Ran stayed close, comforting her.

"Inspector Megure, the toxicology report is ready."

A forensics officer approached with a clipboard. "The victim died from acute poisoning after ingesting a massive amount of arsenic."

"Arsenic?"

Inspector Megure frowned deeply.

"But Inspector, we haven't detected any trace of poison on the utensils or food, let alone arsenic," Officer Takagi reported, looking confused.

Heiji stepped forward.

"Hattori-kun, what do you make of this?" Inspector Megure looked at Heiji with expectation.

Heiji was momentarily speechless. The Inspector isn't stupid, so why does he ask me everything?

"Arsenic usually takes time to work. for death to be this instantaneous, the dosage must have been enormous. Logically, such a large amount should have left significant traces. For there to be absolutely no reaction on the tableware... that is indeed strange."

"What's strange about it? It just proves we aren't the murderers!" Tatsuji Tomizawa shouted loudly.

"Inspector, although I am not a lawyer, if you continue to detain us without evidence, I will file a formal complaint with the Tokyo Metropolitan Police Department," Taichi Tomizawa said calmly, though the threat was clear.

"That's right! If you can't find the murderer, let us go!"

"We don't want to stay in the same room as a corpse any longer!"

Taichi's words resonated with the crowd. The guests began to stir, their anxiety turning into agitation. Inspector Megure did his best to maintain order.

"Hattori-kun, you have to hurry. I won't be able to hold them for much longer."

Heiji frowned, perplexed. The murderer was undoubtedly one of the triplets. But what method had he used to make Tetsuharu Tomizawa ingest a lethal dose of arsenic without leaving a trace on the food or drink?

"I think Heiji Hattori is overrated. Foiling the Night Baron and Kaito Kid must have been pure dumb luck. If you can't solve it, step aside and leave it to the police."

The man in the suit whom Heiji had met in the bathroom sneered from the crowd. His cynical remark found agreement among some of the restless guests.

Whispers of doubt began to spread. Kazuha clenched her fists in anger, and Sonoko glared at the hecklers.

Heiji remained impassive, tuning out the noise. He walked back to the dining table, his eyes darting between the items.

Lobster... Mulberry wine... Heart pills... Arsenic...

Arsenic!

A confident smile slowly curled the corner of Heiji's lips.

The fog had lifted. The mystery was solved.

Shiro Suzuki raised his glass, signaling Tetsuharu Tomizawa to join him.

"Uncle Tomizawa loves lobster. Here, let me serve you a piece."

Ayako Suzuki hurried to place a succulent piece of lobster meat onto Tetsuharu Tomizawa's plate.

"President Suzuki, you have raised a fine daughter. Hahaha!"

Tetsuharu Tomizawa picked up the wine glass in front of him and laughed heartily.

Black wine?

Conan's curiosity was piqued immediately. Pointing to the glass, he asked in his childish voice, "Mister, what kind of wine is that? Why is it pitch black?"

"Ah, this? It's mulberry wine. Yuzo bought it specially for Dad to drink," Taichi Tomizawa explained with a smile.

"Mulberry wine?"

Ran and the others leaned in to look at the glass; the liquid was dark and dense, almost like ink.

"Heiji, what is mulberry wine good for?" Kazuha whispered.

"Mulberry wine is a fruit wine, considered top-tier among its kind. It helps break down fat and prevents the hardening of arteries."

Heiji glanced at the glass. Judging by its deep color and viscosity, it was evident that this was of the highest quality.

"Wow! I should see if I can buy a few bottles for my parents and yours," Kazuha said thoughtfully, tapping her chin.

Heiji smiled faintly. "We can pick some up later."

"Kazuha-neechan, a bottle of that mulberry wine costs over one hundred thousand yen. And if it's vintage, it's even more expensive," Conan suddenly interjected, a mischievous grin on his face.

"Huh!?" Kazuha was dumbfounded.

"Shut up! I don't want to hear another word from you!"

Suddenly, Tetsuharu Tomizawa shouted loudly, slamming his hand on the table.

The hall, which had been full of laughter just moments before, fell into a dead silence. Everyone turned to look in surprise.

A flash of disgust crossed Tomoko Suzuki's eyes. If it weren't for the long-standing relationship between the two families, she would have already lost her temper.

"Dad, I won't say anymore. Please don't be angry." Taichi Tomizawa transferred a piece of lobster from his own plate to his father's, his face apologetic.

"Hmph. If you don't come back to inherit my business, you won't get another cent from me."

Furious, Tetsuharu Tomizawa stabbed the piece of lobster with his fork and ate it aggressively.

"Dad, calm down."

Tatsuji Tomizawa held out the glass of mulberry wine for his father.

"But Dad... I really want to write novels," Taichi murmured in a low voice.

Tetsuharu slammed the wine glass down and glared at his eldest son with fury. But suddenly, his expression twisted. He clutched his body tightly and began to tip backward.

Crash!

Tetsuharu Tomizawa collapsed to the floor, foaming at the mouth, his body convulsing violently.

"Dad! Dad, what's wrong?!"

Yuzo Tomizawa frantically opened a pill bottle, shook out a few tablets, and tried to force his father to swallow them.

"Quick! Someone call an ambulance!" Tomoko Suzuki shouted to the butler.

Moments later, Tetsuharu Tomizawa's convulsions ceased. He lay there, motionless, his eyes wide open and staring at nothing.

"Dad? Dad?"

Taichi Tomizawa reached a trembling hand toward his father's nose. His pupils contracted. "Dad... he's stopped breathing."

Shock rippled through the room.

Dead?

Conan dashed forward and crouched beside the body to examine it.

"You brat, what are you doing? Don't touch my father!" Tatsuji Tomizawa glared at Conan, stepping forward.

"Nobody move! None of you move! You cannot disturb the crime scene!" Conan suddenly shouted, his voice cutting through the panic. "He's already dead!"

Really dead...?

Panic flashed in the guests' eyes. The President of the Tomizawa Group had just died in front of everyone...

"Brat, it's not your place to lecture me."

Taichi Tomizawa grabbed Conan by the collar and tossed him aside roughly.

"Taichi-san, this is a murder investigation. I hope you can cooperate. Otherwise, if I accidentally mistake you for the murderer, it wouldn't look good."

Taichi frowned and looked up. Standing there was the high school student dressed as a knight—Sonoko Suzuki's dance partner.

Without a mission from the system, Heiji hadn't wanted to get involved. But ignoring this would be disrespectful to Sonoko's hospitality. Furthermore, a death like this could cause massive reputational damage to the Suzuki Group if not handled correctly.

"Heiji Hattori? I don't know him."

Taichi was absorbed in his writing and rarely paid attention to the news.

"Heiji is a famous detective! A very good one," Kazuha stated, her tone full of pride.

Detective?

Taichi's heart skipped a beat.

"He is Heiji Hattori? The high school detective who foiled the plots of the Night Baron and Kaito Kid?"

The guests began to whisper among themselves.

"Taichi, Tatsuji, Yuzo... let's leave this matter in Heiji-kun's hands. If it really is a murder, we must bring justice to President Tomizawa, and clear the Suzuki family name."

Tomoko Suzuki was furious. If she didn't have to maintain appearances, she would be screaming. Whether accidental or murder, a death at her party was a disaster.

"In that case... please, Madam. I will go and handle the arrangements." Taichi prepared to leave.

"Wait. No one related to this incident can leave. Stay here and do not move." Heiji's voice was firm.

"What do you mean? Are you implying we would kill our own father?" Tatsuji looked at Heiji with rage.

Heiji met his gaze indifferently. "I am looking at the problem from the perspective of a detective. Please cooperate."

"Heiji-san, on what basis do you say my father was murdered?" Yuzo asked sadly.

"The symptoms of sudden death by heart failure typically involve loss of consciousness, disappearance of the pulse in the carotid arteries, pallor, and pupil dilation, followed by the cessation of breathing..."

"Wasn't my father like that? His pupils dilated, too," Taichi argued, frowning.

Tetsuharu's pupils were indeed dilated, matching the description.

"Did I mention foaming at the mouth?" Heiji glanced at Taichi sharply. "President Tomizawa did not clutch his chest when he fell. He clutched his stomach. This is a clear sign of poisoning."

"Poisoning? Are you saying my father suffered from food poisoning?"

Taichi's words made the blood drain from the guests' faces. They quickly put down their glasses and plates. The way they looked at Tomoko Suzuki shifted from sympathy to suspicion.

"Taichi Tomizawa. Be careful what you say."

Tomoko Suzuki's voice was ice-cold. If the rumor spread that the Suzuki party served poisoned food, the consequences would be catastrophic.

Taichi's face paled, realizing his mistake. "Madam, there has been a misunderstanding. I misspoke, I didn't mean it like that."

"That possibility cannot be ruled out."

Heiji's words exploded like a thunderclap in everyone's mind.

"Heiji! It's impossible for something like that to happen in my house!" Sonoko cried out anxiously.

Hattori is right. It looks like poisoning.

Conan glanced at the lobster on the table, a heavy feeling weighing on his mind.

Heiji gave Sonoko a reassuring look.

"In any case, now we can only wait for the police. Until then, no one leaves or moves freely. Anyone who does will be considered a prime suspect.

[How boring. What's taking them so long?]

Conan leaned back on the sofa, looking utterly bored. He was surrounded by fake smiles and hollow pleasantries—beneath the radiant facades, who knew what schemes were actually brewing?

Suddenly, a hush fell over the room.

Sonoko stood at the top of the stairs, dressed in a stunning black evening gown accented by a crimson shawl that highlighted her fair skin. Her light makeup enhanced her features, making her look more charming than ever.

Beside her stood Ran and Kazuha. At Sonoko's request, they also wore evening gowns—one white, one pink—radiating their own unique charm.

The three girls stood silently at the landing, glancing back expectantly, as if waiting for someone.

The guests looked on curiously. Wasn't Miss Sonoko the star of the show today?

At that moment, a striking figure in crimson emerged from the hallway.

He looked like a knight stepping out of the shadows. Under the spotlight, the deep red of his suit didn't look gaudy; instead, it symbolized mystery and nobility.

Heiji, dressed in this knight's attire, exuded an air of aristocracy. It wasn't about the price of the outfit; it was the way he carried himself.

"Kazuha, remember our deal? You're lending me Heiji for today," Sonoko whispered into Kazuha's ear, pleadingly.

"Alright. If Heiji doesn't mind, neither do I," Kazuha whispered back.

"Thanks, Kazuha!"

Sonoko smiled sweetly. She turned, taking a graceful step with her long legs. Accompanied by a delicate fragrance, she approached Heiji and gently took his arm. "Kazuha said you're mine for tonight."

He glanced at Sonoko, noting the joy and affection clearly visible in her eyes.

"Shall we, my princess?"

Sonoko held tightly onto Heiji's arm, beaming with happiness.

Clap, clap, clap!

As the pair slowly descended the stairs, the hall erupted in applause.

[I never imagined Sonoko could look so adorable when she actually tries.]

Conan looked at Sonoko in surprise, but upon seeing Heiji by her side, his expression darkened, and his eyes narrowed. That guy, Hattori... isn't he afraid Kazuha will get jealous?

Shiro and Tomoko Suzuki watched the scene with smiles on their faces, exchanging a glance before stepping forward to welcome them.

"Happy birthday, darling."

Tomoko kissed Sonoko on the cheek. "Honey, Heiji is a catch. Don't let him get away," she whispered, her voice low enough that only Sonoko could hear.

Sonoko's face flushed instantly, and she shot a sideways glance at her mother.

"Thanks, Mom."

"Sonoko, happy birthday," Shiro Suzuki said kindly.

"Thanks, Dad."

"Happy birthday, Sonoko."

Ayako Suzuki, also in an elegant evening gown, approached and pinched Sonoko's cheek affectionately.

"Ayako, where's my present?" Sonoko asked, looking at her sister.

"You'll get it later. Tonight, you are the star."

Tomoko guided Sonoko to the small stage and gestured for her to address the guests.

Sonoko glanced briefly at Heiji down below. Her expression turned serious as she began her speech.

At a normal birthday party, a formal speech wouldn't be necessary, but as the heiress to a massive conglomerate, these formalities were unavoidable.

"Heiji, you look so handsome."

Down off the stage, Kazuha hugged Heiji's arm, her eyes radiating deep affection.

"Kazuha, watch out. There are a lot of people around," Ran teased.

"I can't help it! Heiji is just too handsome today," Kazuha said, sticking out her tongue playfully.

"I have to agree. Heiji seems to be the most handsome guy here tonight, doesn't he?" Ran laughed softly.

[Damn it. Even Ran...]

Conan, the king of jealousy, felt the vinegar rising in his chest again.

Heiji smiled faintly but didn't engage in their banter, preferring to quietly savor his red wine.

"Tonight, I hope all our distinguished guests enjoy themselves. Thank you all for coming."

Clap, clap, clap!!!

The hall once again filled with thunderous applause.

"Dear guests, let the banquet officially begin."

With Tomoko Suzuki's announcement, elegant music began to fill the mansion—soft enough to serve as background ambiance.

The lights dimmed, and a giant cake, nearly the height of a person, was wheeled into the center of the room.

"Sonoko, go cut the cake."

Sonoko took the knife her mother handed her. She looked at the cake, then suddenly walked over to Heiji.

"Kazuha, I need to borrow Heiji's help. You don't mind, right?"

She looked at Kazuha apologetically, a hint of expectation in her eyes.

"Of course not. Tonight, I leave Heiji to you," Kazuha said generously.

Heiji remained silent, letting himself be led.

The guests had already taken notice of Heiji. First, Tomoko Suzuki had been very warm towards the young man, and now, the Second Miss Suzuki was acting very enthusiastic.

Could he be Sonoko's boyfriend?

Sonoko led Heiji to the cake and handed him the knife. "Heiji, I'm counting on you."

She stood silently to the side, her face flushed and her eyes shining with happiness.

Heiji took the knife and symbolically cut a piece from the bottom tier, handing it to Sonoko. "Beautiful princess, happy birthday."

Sonoko took the cake, but then suddenly stood on her tiptoes and kissed Heiji. Tears welled up in her eyes.

Heiji froze. It wasn't a polite kiss on the cheek—it was right on the lips.

The atmosphere instantly hit its peak as deafening applause roared through the hall.

"Sonoko must have gotten too emotional," Ran said, glancing at Kazuha apologetically.

Kazuha was stunned for a moment, then forced a smile. "Yeah... she must be really overwhelmed."

As the music swelled, Sonoko looked at Heiji with a flushed face. "Heiji, may I have this dance?"

"Of course."

Like a perfect gentleman, Heiji took Sonoko's hand and led her to the dance floor.

As the birthday girl, the floor was theirs alone. Everyone else watched silently from the sidelines as they moved to the music.

Suddenly, a loud, piercing banging was heard on the metal shutter, and sparks flew.

The leader of the robbers stopped squeezing the trigger and shouted, "This is none of your business, get out of here!"

Inside the lobby, everyone was trembling.

"Hurry up, or I'll shoot you!"

Manager Kazuo was pale and covered in cold sweat: "Yes, I'm going right now."

"Go with him. If he dares to make any strange move, blow his head off."

"Understood. Walk."

The barrel of the gun was pressed into Manager Kazuo's back, indicating for him to head down the other corridor. This corridor led to the manager's office, which was also where the vault was located.

Heiji watched everything calmly. He was now completely sure there was a mole in the bank.

"Cooperate with me for a moment."

The cold queen looked at Heiji, a hint of doubt in her cold, beautiful eyes.

"What do I have to do?"

"You just have to do this..."

Heiji's voice reached the woman's ears clearly, but the others noticed nothing.

After listening, the cold queen looked at Heiji, and a look of haughtiness crossed her eyes: "Go yourself."

Heiji almost fell to the floor. He looked at the woman, speechless: "Hey, with such a dangerous situation, can't you sacrifice a little?"

"Feigning illness, I'm not good at it."

The cold queen looked at Heiji and simply closed her eyes, completely ignoring him.

Heiji sighed: "If you're haughty, don't be so cold, and if you're so cold, don't be haughty, or you'll never get married."

While joking with the cold queen, his brain was working at full speed.

[Taking care of these robbers isn't difficult, but finding the mole requires a bit of skill.]

"Why do I have to get married?"

Heiji, who was thinking, almost short-circuited upon hearing the cold queen's words.

He looked at the woman, speechless.

"Forget it, still the cold queen."

The cold queen closed her eyes again, paying not the slightest attention to what was happening around her.

Heiji focused and discreetly observed his surroundings: One robber is standing at the entrance, facing us. The leader is also facing us, his finger on the trigger, ready to shoot at any moment. There are four employees at the counters, two men and two women. The employee who took the bag is at the counter against the wall, the other male employee is near the inner wall, next to an auxiliary table. The two female employees are at their posts, sitting at the counters.

That was the general situation, but it wasn't enough to discover who the mole was.

At the entrance, there was a broken electronic ticket machine, whose screen reflected the light like a mirror...

Seeing the ticket machine and then the people in the counter area, a confident smile formed on Heiji's lips. He had more or less deduced who the mole was.

"Cold queen, want to bet that I can find out who the mole is?"

The cold queen opened her beautiful eyes and looked at Heiji: "Oh."

A simple "oh," neither salty nor bland, neither cold nor hot, neither high nor low...

"Forget it, still the cold queen."

Heiji was completely speechless. I'd better take care of these two criminals first.

The cold queen suddenly looked at Heiji. She felt that the temperament of this boring man had changed. He was now like a cheetah, about to unleash his bloodthirsty fangs.

Suddenly, a gunshot was heard from the direction of the vault.

The leader of the robbers instinctively turned and walked in that direction.

After glancing at the people at the counters, a strange smile appeared on Heiji's lips.

Heiji suddenly stood up and, with incredible speed, lunged at the robber at the entrance. With a single karate chop, the robber fell unconscious. The entire process was as smooth as water, without the slightest pause. Not even the leader, who had his back to the crowd, noticed immediately.

Suddenly, the leader's cell phone rang. He looked sharply towards the door, and his face changed. He turned instantly...

Heiji, who was lunging at full speed, stopped short and calmly looked at the dark gun barrel.

"Not bad. Being able to knock out Saburō Tsuji without making a sound," the leader said in a sinister voice.

Seeing that Heiji had not succeeded, the people who had harbored a glimmer of hope deflated, and their faces were once again filled with despair.

Sonoko turned pale, not from fear, but from concern for Heiji's safety.

"I was behind you, but you looked towards the door. To react so quickly... you're not bad at all either."

Facing the gun barrel, Heiji remained calm.

"Staying calm on the verge of death... truly impressive. Too bad you're going to die."

The leader of the robbers evidently had no intention of wasting time. He tightened his finger on the trigger.

"Heiji~~!!!"

Sonoko suddenly screamed in anguish, and tears welled up in her eyes.

Everyone dared not look, for fear of seeing the scene of brains and blood splashing everywhere.

"What a strange counter-attack technique."

The cold queen looked at Heiji with astonishment. She had never seen such a strange technique. In a single instant, he had snatched the gun from the leader of the robbers.

The leader was paralyzed, his gun gone.

Heiji shot the leader in the leg, and blood gushed out.

"Hmph."

The leader of the robbers was also a tough guy. He only let out a grunt and collapsed to the floor, clutching his leg.

"What happened?"

At that moment, the robber who had entered the vault came out.

With the "bang!" of a gunshot, the pistol in his hand was sent flying.

"Sonoko, tell the police to come in."

Seeing that receding silhouette, Heiji frowned. He had the strange feeling that the woman was familiar.

"Heiji, get in the car."

Kazuha's call came from outside.

"Yeah, I'm coming."

It was still the pink BMW, Heiji was still the one driving, and Conan was still the one sitting in the passenger seat.

Heiji drove very steadily, one hand on the steering wheel and the other resting on the door. Involuntarily, he thought again of the silhouette from a moment ago.

Conan glanced sideways at Heiji: What is this guy, Hattori, thinking about?

"Heiji, can we stop by the bank first? I want to withdraw some money."

Today was Sonoko's birthday. As the second young lady of the Suzuki Corporation, money, naturally, could not be lacking.

There was a bank right ahead. Heiji turned and went straight in.

[This bank...]

Conan's expression suddenly darkened. Masami Hirota's death was something he had always felt very guilty about.

"Shiyou Bank?"

Seeing the bank, Heiji was also surprised. He didn't expect to have such an affinity with this place.

"Ran, Kazuha, and Conan, go wait for us at the pastry shop over there. I need Heiji to be my bodyguard."

"Okay, but hurry up, don't make us wait long," Kazuha said.

"Alright, alright. There aren't many people, we'll be quick. Heiji, let's go."

Heiji shrugged and followed Sonoko with resignation.

"Heiji, how much money do you think I should withdraw?" Sonoko asked, looking at Heiji expectantly.

Heiji was frozen for a moment and looked at her helplessly: "Hey, young lady, how am I supposed to know how much money you have to withdraw? You don't think I'm a god and that I can deduce that too, do you?"

"That's not it... Well, whatever, I don't want to talk to you."

Sonoko seemed to want to say something more, but held back and walked into the bank.

"Wow! Isn't this the second Miss Sonoko of the Suzuki family? Welcome!"

The manager of Shiyou Bank, Kazuo Ebirō, approached Sonoko enthusiastically. If he managed to get this big fish to become a VIP member, he wouldn't have to worry about his results.

"Hello, I've come to withdraw money," Sonoko said naturally.

"Of course, of course. Second Miss Sonoko, would you mind coming to the VIP room to chat for a moment? I assure you I won't take up much of your or your boyfriend's time."

Sonoko was about to refuse, but upon hearing the manager's words, a flash of joy crossed her beautiful eyes: "Alright. Heiji, let's go."

However, Heiji shook his head: "You go, Sonoko. I'll wait for you in the lobby."

VIP rooms in banks were not unknown to him; they had long since lost their mystery for him.

"Well, but don't sneak away halfway through."

Since she had already agreed, Sonoko couldn't back out, but she also didn't want Heiji to leave early.

Heiji nodded and sat down directly in the lobby, picking up a nearby newspaper to read.

It turned out the headline was still about the Queen Sallybeth incident.

The newspaper praised him to the skies, saying he was the reincarnation of Sherlock Holmes, that his intelligence was comparable to Einstein's... Heiji was speechless as he read it.

The media all over the world is the same.

Heiji knew very well that the next time he made the slightest mistake, they would pounce on him with fierce criticism. The media are a bunch of weather vanes; he would be a fool to trust them.

"What is this newspaper on about? Didn't they fail to catch the Night Baron? They just found the Dark Star by chance, and yet they praise this Heiji Hattori so much."

Heiji smiled slightly. There was no need to pay attention to the opinions of the ignorant.

Click, clack, clack~~!!!

The crisp sound of high heels was heard, followed by a light fragrance and a faint smell of medicine.

[The smell of chemical products?]

Heiji frowned, put down the newspaper, and looked at the newcomer.

Shoulder-length orange hair, an exquisite face with beautiful clear eyes that emitted a cold gaze, and thin pink lips slightly curved, like a queen's smile, cold and haughty.

Her tall figure, around one meter sixty-five, was wrapped in a blood-red dress that enhanced her curves. The dress came to ten centimeters above the knee, revealing long, white, and slender legs, shod in a pair of matching blood-red high heels, which swayed with each step.

She was a beautiful woman, but her temperament was like ice, extremely cold.

"Hello, I'd like to ask..."

"Excuse me, miss, if you wish to conduct any business, please take a number and wait for your turn," the bank teller said politely.

The woman was frozen for a moment, then silently took a number, glanced around the lobby, and sat down directly next to Heiji.

The smell of chemical products became more intense.

The more Heiji looked at her, the more familiar she seemed...

The woman, who had her head down, felt Heiji's gaze and slowly raised it to look at him...

Their eyes met!

"Miss, you do not seem like an ordinary person."

Heiji looked at her calmly.

"Is something wrong?"

A cold voice, a tone indifferent to everything, like a haughty queen.

"You give off a faint smell of chemical products, and although your hands are white and delicate, you still have traces of medicinal powder on your nails. Your posture when you sit is straight, without leaning against the backrest, and your hands rest naturally on your legs. It is evident that you work in a laboratory, in the chemistry area."

Heiji deduced with confidence. It was the first time he had bothered to talk so much to a stranger.

The woman responded with an indifferent sound and continued to stare at the electronic screen.

[So cold and distant.]

Heiji could see that the woman was not faking it. That coldness emanated from within her, without the slightest artifice.

SCREECH~!!!

A silver three-wheeled car braked sharply at the entrance. The doors opened and three men rushed out of the vehicle. They all had their faces covered and were carrying submachine guns.

They entered and fired directly at the glass partitions, which shattered. This way, there was nothing left separating the lobby from the counter area.

The bank was filled with screams of panic.

"It's a robbery! If you don't want to die, shut the fuck up!"

When one of the masked men spoke, the lobby instantly fell silent. Everyone was trembling with fear.

Satisfied with the people's reaction, the masked man turned to another robber: "Close the main door."

That robber went directly to a counter and pointed his submachine gun at the female employee: "Close the main door."

A glint shone in Heiji's eyes. He discreetly looked at the bank employees and a cold smile formed on his lips.

Clank, clank!!!

The main door was an explosion-proof security shutter. It slowly lowered, trapping everyone inside.

Once the door was closed, of the three robbers, one stayed at the entrance, another in the staff corridor, and the leader, with his back to the counters, looked at Heiji and the others with arrogance.

"We just want money. You'd better behave and not try anything funny, or I'll blow your head off with one shot."

"Hey, what do you want to do?"

A large black bag was thrown to them: "Fill this with money, quick!"

That robber remained with his back to the employees behind the counter.

A glint of insight flickered in Heiji's eyes. This group of robbers was very interesting.

Although several days had already passed since the Queen Sallybeth incident and neither the Night Baron nor Kaito Kid had been captured, the repercussion was still immense. Heiji, in particular, had shot to fame overnight, becoming gradually known throughout Japan and becoming a representative figure of the new generation.

"A new and great contemporary detective, comparable to Sherlock Holmes."

"The most promising high school student of the 21st century."

"Miracle! The prodigious boy from Osaka confronts two great thieves."

"An unexpected turn! The pearl of darkness, lost and recovered."

"A superior intellect, a terrifying insight, an unparalleled deductive ability: he is the Sherlock Holmes of Osaka, Heiji Hattori."

"Damn it, this Hattori brat has stolen all my spotlight."

Kogoro Mouri slammed the newspaper on the table in annoyance. Every single page was about Heiji Hattori.

Conan put down his backpack, with a frustrated expression.

"You're back, Conan. Hey, did you not have a good day at school?" Ran asked, confused.

[Heh, heh, how am I supposed to be happy when I've spent the whole day hearing about the exploits of that guy, Hattori?]

Conan rolled his eyes and then rested his chin in his hand: Why was Hattori so careless as to be attacked from behind by the Night Baron while chasing Kaito Kid? Was it on purpose or unintentional?

In the corridor of the Queen Sallybeth, there was nowhere to hide. If he had been chasing him, and the Night Baron had been in front, Kaito Kid would have seen him too. But if the Night Baron attacked him from behind, then Heiji was too careless, which doesn't fit with the personality he had shown so far.

Precisely for that reason, Conan was suspicious. Of course, for now, it was just a slight doubt, and he hadn't gone so far as to think that Heiji was the Night Baron.

Osaka's Kaiho Academy!

"Look, it's Heiji Hattori!"

"So handsome!!!"

"To be able to ruin the plans of both Kaito Kid and the Night Baron, it's incredible."

"I want to be his girlfriend."

"Me too. I'm so cute, I'm sure I'm worthy."

On campus, wherever Heiji went, these comments were heard. People turned their heads to look at him one hundred percent of the time; it was no exaggeration to say he was the center of attention.

"How annoying! How can those girls be so shameless?"

Kazuha came running up, pouting in discontent.

Heiji smiled slightly and tapped Kazuha's nose: "Silly, let them say what they want, what do you care?"

"But, Heiji, have you seen your locker?" Kazuha said, still pouting.

"No, don't you always clean it for me?"

"Every day it's stuffed with love letters, with photos attached. Many are from very cute girls," Kazuha said, somewhat dejected.

"Oh, really? And where are those letters now?"

Heiji looked very interested.

"I've burned them."

Kazuha suddenly lifted her head and looked at Heiji defiantly.

Heiji couldn't help but laugh.

"What are you laughing at? Don't laugh! I am your girlfriend, Heiji. I won't allow any other girl to get near you," Kazuha said possessively.

"Well, if you burned them, you burned them. It's time to go home."

Heiji walked down the street with his hands in his pockets. Kazuha followed happily by his side, her beautiful eyes occasionally glancing at her boyfriend, shining with deep happiness.

The evening light stretched the shadows of the two.

Hattori Residence!

"Hello, Hattori residence."

"Hello, is Mr. Hattori there, please?"

A pleasant voice sounded on the other end of the phone.

"Yes, he is. Do you need something from him?"

"Yes, it's very important. Could you please ask him to come to the phone?"

The voice seemed somewhat nervous.

Shizuka Hattori frowned: This son of mine... Kazuha isn't enough for him, and on top of that, he's going around messing with other girls. It seems I'll have to have a serious talk with him.

"Heiji, it's for you."

Heiji felt a bit bewildered. Why was his mother's tone so strange?

"Hello, this is Heiji Hattori."

"Heiji, it's Sonoko!" the voice on the other end of the phone was full of joy.

"Oh, Sonoko. What's up?"

Beside him, Shizuka Hattori pricked up her ears. Heiji was instantly speechless.

"It's nothing, it's just that Saturday is my birthday and I wanted to invite you and Kazuha to my party. It doesn't matter that you're in Osaka, I can send a helicopter to pick you up."

[A helicopter?]

Shizuka Hattori looked at Heiji in surprise. The girl on the phone was very rich.

"No need. It's only a few hours from Osaka to Tokyo. I'll ask Kazuha if she wants to go and I'll let you know."

"Kazuha already said she's going, I just need you to tell me if you're going."

Sonoko replied immediately over the phone, giving Heiji no chance to hesitate.

Heiji thought for a moment. He didn't seem to have anything to do on Saturday and Sunday.

"Okay, when is the party?"

"Saturday at eight in the evening. But during the day I'm going shopping, so you have to arrive at ten in the morning, don't you dare be late... It's settled then, bye!"

After spitting out a barrage of words, Sonoko hung up directly.

Hearing the busy tone, Heiji's face darkened. This woman, Sonoko...

"You, scoundrel. You have a girl as adorable and sensible as Kazuha and you're still not satisfied. These last few days girls keep calling. I'm warning you, I will only recognize Kazuha as my daughter-in-law. No matter how cute the others are, I won't accept them."

As soon as Heiji hung up the phone, Shizuka Hattori started lecturing him non-stop.

Half an hour, she lectured him for a whole half hour.

"In short, you can't hurt Kazuha, understand?"

Finally, Shizuka Hattori got tired and, leaving a completely stunned Heiji, went back to her room.

"Hahaha, did the lady really say that to you?"

The next day, after Heiji told Kazuha about the previous night, the girl burst out laughing.

"Getting your future mother-in-law's approval makes you very happy, doesn't it?"

Hearing Heiji's joke, Kazuha instantly stopped laughing and glared at him, blushing.

The train sped along. No incidents occurred on the way; after all, Heiji didn't have the attribute of attracting death.

A few hours later, they finally arrived at Beika station.

"Heiji, Kazuha, here... over here!"

Sonoko waved enthusiastically from outside the station. Beside her were a smiling Ran and a frustrated Conan.

"Ran, Sonoko, and Conan!"

Kazuha's face lit up with joy and she ran to meet them.

Heiji followed with his hands in his pockets and a serene expression, a slight smile of confidence on his lips.

At that moment, a tall and sexy woman, with shoulder-length orange hair, walked past Heiji, followed by several men in black who were walking in a hurry.

At the stern of the ship, there were only a few dim lights and everything else was dark. Finding a bright spot was extremely easy.

"I've found it."

The first part of the sentence seemed completely natural to Conan, but the second was like swallowing a fly: Is this girl, Sonoko, saying I'm not as good as Hattori? Damn woman!!!

"Really? Quick, take down that security light."

The only place with light here was this lamp. Tomoko Suzuki said urgently.

"Quick, dismantle the security light!" Inspector Nakamori ordered his men.

Conan watched from the side, full of confidence. He glanced sideways at Heiji with a smug expression: Hattori, I won this time.

Heiji watched everything calmly, a malicious smile on his lips.

"Heiji-niichan, what are you laughing at?"

Conan, who was keeping a close eye on Heiji, felt his heart skip a beat when he saw him smile. Could I have been mistaken? He quickly looked at Inspector Nakamori.

The security light had been dismantled, but in the box where it was installed, there was nothing.

"Dismantle the lamp, it might be inside."

Inspector Nakamori was not giving up.

[That's not right, it's surely not inside. Something as valuable as the Dark Star can't be too close to a light source. The heat emitted by the lamp could damage it. The Night Baron would never do something like that. Damn it, I was wrong again.]

Conan furiously punched a nearby machine, an expression of frustration on his face.

"Madam, there's nothing here."

Inspector Nakamori shook his head, disappointed.

Tomoko Suzuki was instantly disillusioned and looked at Sonoko: "Sonoko, summon the media immediately. Tell the Night Baron that if he is willing to return the Dark Star, the Suzuki Corporation will not only press no charges, but is also willing to pay him five billion yen as a ransom for the jewel."

Gasp!!!

Those present couldn't help but hold their breath. Five billion yen... the Suzuki Corporation was truly immensely wealthy.

"Mrs. Suzuki, you are encouraging crime. We cannot allow this," Inspector Nakamori said seriously.

Tomoko Suzuki gave him an indifferent look: "I didn't say I needed your permission. What's the rush? As long as the Dark Star is safe, the Suzuki Corporation will not press charges against the Night Baron."

"Alright, Mom. I'll call the press conference right now."

Sonoko's capability was impressive. As the second young lady of the Suzuki Corporation, it was to be expected that she would have certain skills.

"Don't worry, madam. The Dark Star is still here," Heiji said with confidence.

Conan looked at Heiji, his brow furrowed and very bewildered: I'm sure I haven't misunderstood the meaning of that phrase. But in this place, apart from that security light, where else is there light?

"Heiji, you can't fool me. The sooner the news is published, the safer the Dark Star will be. If the Night Baron sells it abroad, money will no longer be able to solve the problem," Tomoko Suzuki said seriously.

"Don't worry, madam. The Dark Star is here, without a doubt. Because the Night Baron is surely still on this ship; he wouldn't carry something so valuable on him."

"Heiji-niichan, could I have misunderstood the meaning of that phrase?" Conan asked, feigning innocence.

Heiji smiled maliciously: "I've already told you, don't learn too much from Kudo's reasoning. His way of deducing is not enough, it's too shallow."

[Heh, heh!]

Conan rolled his eyes, his face grim: You're not one to lecture me, Hattori.

Heiji put his hands in his pockets and slowly walked towards a spot, radiating great confidence.

"Under the bright night sky, I will take this jewel of the night. This sentence has two keys. One is the one little Conan mentioned, 'bright,' and the other is 'night sky'."

"Night sky?"

Everyone looked at each other and instinctively looked up at the sky. It was completely dark, with only a full moon hanging high above.

[Night sky???]

Conan lowered his head, thoughtful, and examined the spot where Heiji was. Suddenly, his pupils dilated: Don't tell me it's...

"Inspector Nakamori, please, ask some of your officers to go down into these fish tanks."

In front of where Heiji was, there were five square, sunken pits. They were about 2 meters deep and covered with a wire mesh. They were normally used to store fish.

"You guys, be careful," Inspector Nakamori ordered.

Several policemen went down into the pits and shouted: "Inspector Nakamori, we're ready!"

Inspector Nakamori looked at Heiji, awaiting his next instruction.

[I get it, I get it. So that was it.]

On the side, Conan was completely stunned. The meaning of that phrase was that.

"Now, please, officers, look towards the night sky and describe what you see," Heiji said calmly.

"From here I can only see a completely dark night sky," said the officer in the first pit.

"It's better from here, I can see a piece of the moon," said the officer in the second pit.

"From here I can see almost half the moon," said the officer in the third pit.

"From here I can see a large part of the moon, it's very bright," said the officer in the fourth pit.

"From here you can only see the moon! You can't see any of the night sky, it's incredibly dazzling!" said the officer in the fifth pit excitedly.

"'Under the bright night sky'... 'bright night sky'... I know! The Dark Star is in the fifth pit!" Sonoko suddenly exclaimed.

Hearing Sonoko's reminder, everyone present suddenly understood.

"Quick! See what's in there!" shouted Inspector Nakamori.

The officer in the fifth pit looked down to check: "I don't see anything, just a water outlet, but it's clogged."

"Nothing? Was I wrong?" Sonoko said, somewhat disappointed.

[Impossible, it has to be there. This can't be wrong.]

Conan ran to the fifth pit and looked through the wire mesh.

"Please, officer in the fifth pit, remove what's obstructing the water outlet. I believe the Dark Star is in there."

Shortly after!

"I've found it! It's a case!" shouted the officer in the fifth pit cheerfully.

"Officer, give it to me, I'll take it," Conan said, extending his hand to take it.

"Be careful, little one. Hey, little one, don't open it!"

The officer in the fifth pit handed the case to Conan, but he opened it directly...

A black pearl, completely simple and without luster, lay quietly inside, as dark as ink.

"It's the real Dark Star."

"We've recovered the Dark Star!"

The stern of the ship erupted in jubilation. Heiji smiled slightly, his hands in his pockets, and looked up at the night sky at a forty-five-degree angle.

"Congratulations, host, for completing the A-class mission. 500 evil points have been eliminated."

Kazuha, along with Ran and Sonoko, was looking for Heiji everywhere. They hadn't seen him from the beginning, and the girl was worried.

"I'm here."

Heiji came out of a corner, rubbing his head with an expression of pain.

Kazuha ran to him and held him, full of worry: "Heiji, what happened to you?"

"It's nothing, just that while I was chasing Kaito Kid, someone hit me from behind and knocked me unconscious," Heiji said with a slightly pained expression.

"It must have been the Night Baron. After Kaito Kid appeared, he appeared. To attack Heiji from behind... I won't forgive him," Sonoko said angrily.

"The Night Baron came too?" Heiji asked, feigning confusion.

"Yes, this is what happened."

Ran told him everything that had occurred from the beginning.

Heiji listened with a glint in his eyes; his expression was worthy of an Oscar.

"Kazuha, take me to Inspector Nakamori."

Inspector Chaki and Inspector Nakamori were on the deck, directing all the policemen in a thorough search. They didn't believe that Kaito Kid and the Night Baron could have disappeared out of thin air; they were surely hidden somewhere on the cruise ship.

Conan didn't believe it either. He was running all over the ship looking for clues.

"Inspector Nakamori, have you found my Dark Star?" Tomoko Suzuki asked as she came out.

"Well... Madam, I'm very sorry. The Night Baron took the Dark Star."

Inspector Nakamori felt very ashamed. Dozens of policemen had been unable to catch two thieves, and they had also been mocked in front of so many people.

"It was stolen? My Dark Star, the treasure of the Suzuki family..."

Tomoko Suzuki looked as if she was about to faint.

"Mom~~!!"

At that moment, Heiji and the others arrived. Sonoko ran to support Tomoko Suzuki.

"Inspector Nakamori, Heiji says he knows where the Dark Star is hidden," said Kazuha, who was supporting Heiji.

"WHAT?" shouted Inspector Nakamori and Conan, who had just arrived, in unison.

"Conan, don't run around. What if you get lost?" Ran scolded him.

"Hey, hey, Heiji-niichan, do you know where the Dark Star is hidden?"

Conan completely ignored Ran. In his mind, there was only the Night Baron and Kaito Kid... He was convinced it was impossible for them to have appeared and disappeared out of thin air.

[A disguise!!! Those two used the flash of light to disguise themselves and blend into the crowd to escape.]

Conan was firmly convinced of this idea.

"Heiji, do you know? Where is the Dark Star?"

Tomoko Suzuki was now quite distraught. The Dark Star was too important to the Suzuki family; the loss of the family treasure was a very serious matter.

"Young Hattori, do you really know?" Inspector Nakamori looked at Heiji with expectation.

"The Night Baron has not left this ship. He used the flash of light to escape, but that was just a sham. His goal was to create chaos to blend into the crowd," Heiji said slowly.

Conan frowned: "Heiji-niichan, what happened to you?"

"The Night Baron attacked Heiji from behind. What a bastard!" Sonoko said, unable to contain her anger.

"Attacked by the Night Baron? When?" Conan asked, surprised.

"Just before. It turns out Heiji had already gone out to chase him, but he didn't expect the Night Baron to attack him from behind," Ran said in a low voice.

[Could there be such a coincidence?]

Conan touched his chin and sank into thought.

Heiji glanced sideways at Conan: He knew this boy would be suspicious. But it doesn't matter, he won't find any clues anyway. The system has already erased all traces.

"Do you remember the Night Baron's words?"

"I remember he said something like 'I will arrive shrouded in the dense darkness and, under the bright night sky, I will take this jewel of the darkness'," Ran recalled.

"That sentence already tells us where the Dark Star is," Heiji said in a low voice.

Conan looked at Heiji sharply: "Heiji-niichan, do you know where the Dark Star is?"

"Ouch, that hurts!" Conan shouted, rubbing his head.

Sonoko withdrew her fist and glared at Conan: "Don't interrupt Heiji while he's working. Let him finish quickly so he can go and rest."

Conan rubbed his head, annoyed.

"Ran said the Night Baron spoke to you from the top of that mast, right?"

Heiji looked up at the cruise ship's mast. It stood imposing, several tens of meters high.

"He disappeared up there," Inspector Nakamori nodded.

Conan looked at Heiji. What's the point of asking that?

"Don't you find it strange? At tens of meters high, and yet you could hear him speak..."

Heiji's words echoed like thunder in Conan's mind, leaving him paralyzed.

[That detail... how have I overlooked it all this time?]

"You mean a loudspeaker?" shouted Inspector Nakamori.

"Yes. If I'm not mistaken, there must be a hidden loudspeaker somewhere on the Queen Sallybeth," Heiji said with confidence.

"Attention all units! Immediately search the ship for a loudspeaker that does not belong to the vessel," Inspector Nakamori roared into the radio.

"Cooperate with Inspector Nakamori immediately, quick!" Inspector Chaki also shouted into the radio.

All the policemen on the ship got moving again, searching everywhere for that supposed loudspeaker.

"Inspector Nakamori, we've found the loudspeaker."

The cheerful voice of a policeman came over the radio.

"Stay there and don't let anyone get close. I'm on my way immediately."

Conan forged ahead and was the first to run.

"Conan, this kid, really..." Ran couldn't even stop him.

"Let's go too."

Heiji said calmly. He no longer needed to be supported; overdoing the act would be suspicious.

When Heiji and the others arrived, Inspector Nakamori had already dismantled the loudspeaker and was inspecting it.

"Inspector Nakamori, what are you doing?" Heiji asked, speechless.

"Heiji, the Dark Star isn't here," Tomoko Suzuki said, disappointed.

Heiji was speechless.

"Madam, I didn't say the Dark Star was hidden in the loudspeaker. Please, don't worry."

"What? But we've already destroyed the loudspeaker," Inspector Nakamori said, dejected.

"Uh, it doesn't matter that it's broken. Its mission is already over."

Heiji glanced around and a confident smile formed on his lips.

"The location of the loudspeaker confirms the part of the Night Baron's phrase that says 'I will arrive shrouded in the dense darkness.' The stern is the machinery and storage area, not open to the public. Its darkness fits the meaning of the phrase. And now, what do you think was the first thing the Night Baron did when he boarded the ship?"

Heiji asked calmly.

Everyone began to think.

"Install the loudspeaker. Because if he didn't install it at the first moment, he wouldn't have had time to prepare it later," Conan suddenly shouted, his heart filled with astonishment.

Heiji looked at Conan and frowned.

[Damn, could this guy, Hattori, have discovered something?]

Conan felt a chill on the back of his neck: My deduction just now was a bit excessive.

"Correct! This little one is right!" Inspector Nakamori exclaimed, clapping his hands.

"That's right, that's it. Therefore, if we find the location of the loudspeaker, we can find the next clue."

"What clue?"

"Under the bright night sky, I will take this jewel of the night."

[Under the bright night sky, I will take this jewel of the night.]

Conan's thought synchronized with Heiji's words.

Those present were frozen, a look of confusion on their faces.

Kaito Kid was running at full speed. Suddenly, he looked back, his pupils contracted sharply, and he said through gritted teeth:

"Night Baron?"

Under the mask, Heiji's lips curved into a malicious smile. His throat vibrated, modifying his voice.

"When evil calls, a gentleman of the night never fails to arrive. White-skinned bird, the Dark Star in your hands belongs to the gentleman of the night."

"Less chatter. Let's see how you chase me today."

Kaito Kid wanted revenge for the last time, when he was chased through several prefectures.

Poof~~!!!

The hang glider deployed instantly. Kaito Kid jumped onto the ship's railing and, with a push, launched himself directly from the fifth floor.

Heiji had no intention of flying after Kaito Kid.

Flying away was easy, but coming back would be complicated, and then it would be difficult to explain.

With a thought, the hidden coin gun in his hand appeared instantly. He aimed at the supports of Kaito Kid's hang glider and fired twice. "Bang!" "Bang!".

Kaito Kid, who had barely gotten a few meters away, stopped short and, like a bird with broken wings, plummeted towards the first-floor deck.

"Damn it!!!"

Kaito Kid's face changed. This way, he wouldn't be able to fly away.

At that moment, the policemen patrolling outside had already seen them.

"It's the Night Baron and Kaito Kid!"

The loud shout echoed throughout the Queen Sallybeth.

[The Night Baron has also appeared???]

Conan, who had just run out of the grand hall, changed his expression and quickened his pace.

Kaito Kid had already landed on the first floor, but Heiji was still on the fifth, and there were already policemen running towards him from behind.

"Night Baron, you are under arrest! Don't move!"

Countless gun barrels were aimed at Heiji.

Da, da, da!!!

Conan came running down the corridor, followed by Inspector Chaki and Inspector Nakamori.

"Night Baron, don't move!",

Inspector Chaki shouted as he ran.

"Night Baron, today I'm going to arrest both you and Kaito Kid!"

Inspector Nakamori, for some reason, also felt a deep animosity towards the Night Baron. He had probably transferred some of the anger he felt for Kaito Kid to him.

Heiji smiled slightly: "A gentleman of the night never surrenders to the weapons of evil."

As soon as he finished speaking, he jumped onto the railing and launched himself downwards, like a blood-swallow from a cliff, his crimson tailcoat fluttering in the wind.

[Damn it!!! I won't let you escape!]

Conan gritted his teeth, activated the button on his power-enhancing shoes, and kicked a soccer ball: "Knock him down!"

A flash of light crossed the night sky, accompanied by a loud whistle, flying at full speed towards Heiji, who was descending in a dive.

"If that ball hits him, the Night Baron's identity will definitely be exposed."

Kaito Kid muttered from below.

Heiji didn't rely on a hang glider to glide; his entire body could do it. The ball was fast, but it also created wind...

"What? How is that possible?"

The Night Baron's body suddenly rose into the air. The ball, carrying tremendous force, passed directly under him and crashed with a "thud!" onto the first-floor deck.

Seeing the force of that ball, Kaito Kid broke out in a cold sweat. A kid kicked that?

A gust of wind hit him, and Heiji had already landed on the first-floor deck.

Around him were some guests and several policemen.

"Kaito Kid, give me the Dark Star in your hands and I'll let you go."

Heiji aimed his hidden pistol at Kaito Kid, his modified voice held an unquestionable tone.

"What makes you think I can't escape on my own?" Kaito Kid said confidently.

"You can try," Heiji said indifferently.

Kaito Kid fell silent. His tricks always worked because no one could figure them out. But if the Night Baron figured them out, his chances of escaping would decrease.

"Well, it seems I won't be able to take this Dark Star with me."

Kaito Kid was one of those who don't cling to things. Since he couldn't take it, he took it out directly and threw it to Heiji, along with the handkerchief.

It wasn't even necessary to look at it to know it was the real Dark Star; the feeling to the touch through the handkerchief was completely different.

"Night Baron, we'll meet again. And next time, I'll be the one taking the initiative."

Kaito Kid smiled confidently, held five flash grenades between his fingers, and threw them in various directions.

Several muffled explosions were heard, and Kaito Kid's body was engulfed in an intense light that shot out in all directions.

Conan shouted in anger, but he had no choice but to close his eyes. The light from several flash grenades was very painful to the eyes.

When the light dissipated, Kaito Kid's figure was no longer on the first-floor deck...

"Report to Inspector Chaki, the Night Baron and Kaito Kid have disappeared."

The voice of an officer from the first floor came over the radio.

"There! The Night Baron is on the mast!"

Conan's sharp eyes discovered that the Night Baron was standing at the highest point of the cruise ship, several tens of meters above the ground.

"Night Baron, surrender at once! We have helicopters, you can't escape!"

Inspector Nakamori shouted at the sky with a megaphone, at the top of his lungs.

Many guests came out from every floor; almost all of Japan's most prestigious merchants and officials were there.

Kazuha, Ran, and Sonoko also came out. Holding hands, they looked at the blood-red figure high above, who, under the light of the helicopters, looked especially mysterious with his fluttering tailcoat.

"And Heiji???"

However, they were worried about where another person was.

Heiji, standing atop the mast, looked at the figures that looked like ants below and held up the Dark Star.

"As a gentleman of the night, I said I would come shrouded in the dense darkness and that, under the bright night sky, I would take this jewel of the darkness."

[The bright night sky? Damn it, he's going to use flash grenades!]

Conan's face changed. He ran to Inspector Nakamori's side and shouted: "The Night Baron is going to use flash grenades! Tell the helicopter pilots to disperse and surround him!"

However!!!

It was too late.

Suddenly, a series of fireworks erupted around the Queen Sallybeth. The roar was incessant, and the flowers of light that exploded in the air completely illuminated the dark night sky.

Now, the figure of the Night Baron was completely exposed to everyone's view.

A blood-red cape, a blood-red tailcoat, a pale white mask. With one hand in his pocket and the other holding the Dark Star, he stood tens of meters high, mysterious and noble, unattainable.

"A gentleman!!!"

This word involuntarily sprang into everyone's mind.

"Ladies and gentlemen, when evil descends again, that will be the day the gentleman of the night and you meet again."

No one knew how, despite being tens of meters high, the Night Baron's voice reached everyone's ears. As his words ended, an intense light suddenly burst around him and, in an instant, he disappeared.

But atop the mast, there was no one left.

"Damn it, he got away again."

Conan gritted his teeth in anger, feeling a deep frustration.

The night was calm, but in everyone's ears, the whistle of the wind still echoed.

"Heiji, are you going to do a kendo demonstration?" Ran asked, her eyes shining.

"Oh, that's right! I had forgotten that Heiji's kendo is also very good. He's the captain of our school's kendo club," Kazuha said with pride.

"My God, Heiji! Is there anything you can't do?" Sonoko said with admiration.

"Yes, giving birth, I don't know how to do that."

The three girls were frozen for a moment, and then they glared at him, blushing.

[This guy, Hattori...]

Conan started to feel jealous again.

"Uh, what happened?" Heiji asked again.

"Since you weren't ready yet, Mr. Sanada Kazumi said he was going to perform a magic trick for everyone," Kazuha explained.

"Oh."

Heiji looked over there with boredom.

Sanada Kazumi took out an immaculate white handkerchief, gently wrapped the Dark Star that Tomoko Suzuki had given him, and held it delicately through the cloth.

"Please, pay attention to my hand. I now have the Dark Star held between my index finger and my thumb. Watch closely..."

All eyes were fixed on Sanada Kazumi's hand holding the Dark Star. Suddenly, he closed his hand tightly, and when he opened it again, the Dark Star had disappeared.

Tomoko Suzuki's gaze flickered for an instant, but she showed no change in her expression.

"Please, look here. The Dark Star is here."

He turned his other hand over, and the Dark Star appeared, indeed, in the palm of his hand...

The room burst into applause. Although it was a simple magic trick, it was truly brilliant. In the blink of an eye, the Dark Star had passed from one hand to the other, with astonishing speed.

Heiji shook his head. Using language to distract the audience's attention... in reality, the Dark Star had already been transferred to the other hand much earlier. Such a simple trick, commonly known as sleight of hand.

However, Sanada Kazumi was worthy of being called a brilliant magician. His movements were fluid, without the slightest pause, and that was the key to this magic trick.

"Wow, what an incredible magic trick," Ran said with admiration.

Conan scoffed with disdain. Evidently, he had also seen the key to the trick.

"Thank you all very much. Now, I will return this Dark Star to its owner."

Sanada Kazumi handed the Dark Star, wrapped in the handkerchief, to Tomoko Suzuki.

Seeing this gesture, Heiji frowned and a cold smile formed on his lips.

"Madam, that one is fake."

Tomoko Suzuki, who was about to take it, reflexively withdrew her hand upon hearing Heiji's words and looked at him in surprise.

Sanada Kazumi was frozen for a moment, then looked at Heiji and a malicious smile appeared on his lips: "It seems I've been discovered."

With that, he abruptly pulled the mask from his face and, at the same time, tore off his clothes.

An immaculate white suit, a monocle on his right eye, a white top hat... that characteristic combination...

"A-class mission officially initiated. Snatch the Dark Star from the hands of Kaito Kid. Time limit: one hour."

The relentless voice of the system suddenly sounded.

Heiji couldn't help but twitch the corner of his lips. He finally understood what "to be determined" meant. It turns out the mission would only be officially announced after confirming that Kaito Kid had actually obtained the Dark Star.

"Kaito Kid!!!"

"Kaito Kid has appeared!"

The scene descended into chaos.

"Don't panic, don't panic! Stay where you are and don't move!",

Inspector Chaki shouted.

[Kaito Kid has come. What about the Night Baron?]

Conan looked around with a grave expression. He was sure the two thieves would appear at the same time. However, he didn't see that striking blood-red figure anywhere.

"Worthy of being Kaito Kid. I didn't expect at all that you would use a double disguise."

Heiji also hadn't expected that Sanada Kazumi was actually Kid in disguise.

Who could have imagined it? First, he disguised himself as Shiro Suzuki, and then as Sanada Kazumi. Such an unexpected move was truly impossible to foresee.

"I also didn't expect there to be someone like you among the guests. Discovering my disguise twice, impressive."

Kaito Kid praised him sincerely. It was the first time someone had discovered his identity so cleanly and directly.

"Your disguise as Sanada Kazumi was perfect. After all, you were acting as yourself, flawless. A pity you did that magic trick," Heiji said calmly.

"Oh, may I know the reason?"

Kaito Kid also didn't know where he had gone wrong. In theory, there shouldn't have been any flaw.

"You surely already knew that the real Dark Star was in Mrs. Tomoko's possession, that's why you prepared this double disguise insurance."

"That's right."

"And that was your mistake. The real Dark Star is very old and simple. With the passage of time, it has lost its luster and is even extremely susceptible to corrosion. At first, when you took the Dark Star from Mrs. Tomoko's hands, you were extremely careful, you didn't even dare to squeeze it hard, for fear that sweat would seep through the handkerchief and stain this priceless jewel. However, after the magic trick, your movements became much more careless, you even held it in your hand... There is only one explanation for such a change: the Dark Star was switched. Are you satisfied with this explanation?"

Heiji looked at Kaito Kid calmly.

"Impressive. It seems that in the future I'll have to be very careful with you, I can't leave even the slightest trace. I take back what I thought before, not all detectives are nitpicking critics who just follow in a thief's footsteps. At least, you, Heiji Hattori, are not."

"Quick, catch him!"

"No! My Dark Star is still in his possession!" Tomoko Suzuki shouted, desperate.

"I'll be taking this jewel of the darkness."

The fake Dark Star that Kaito Kid was about to return to Tomoko Suzuki suddenly fell to the floor.

A dazzling flash of light was released in the hall. Everyone instinctively covered their eyes, crying out in pain.

Heiji, a second before, had covered Kazuha's eyes, but his ears were attentive to the sounds around him.

Rattle, rattle!

The sound of pearls rolling on the floor was heard.

Heiji frowned and snapped his eyes open. The bright light had just disappeared, and he adapted instantly.

A dozen pearls similar to the Dark Star burst on the floor, releasing a thick smoke that completely covered the entire hall.

"Quick, block the door! Quick! Cough, cough..."

Inspector Chaki almost choked on the smoke.

"You three, hold hands and don't separate. I'll be right back."

Heiji took Ran and Sonoko's hands and pulled them over to Kazuha. After giving them instructions, he ran quickly through the smoke.

Relying on his memory, he was out the main door of the grand hall in an instant...

"Don't move! Close the door, close the door!"

The grand hall was in chaos, and Inspector Chaki's shouts were lost in the tumult.

[Damn it, they've locked me in.]

Conan kicked the door in anger. The policeman beside him wouldn't let him out no matter what.

Kaito Kid was running at full speed down a corridor. Some of the lower-status guests in the hallway watched him run past, stunned, standing frozen in place.

"Kaito Kid???"

However, shortly after, another blood-red figure ran past them.

"The Night Baron???"

Those people were dumbstruck.

The hall was thrown into chaos. Everyone was whispering, not understanding Tomoko Suzuki's intentions.

"Excuse me, Inspector Chaki, but he is not my husband. Mr. Sanada Kazumi, you can show your true face now."

With a swift movement, the fake Shiro Suzuki removed his disguise, revealing a very handsome man.

"Madam, distinguished guests, good evening."

"What is happening?"

"How is this possible?"

"Please, do not be alarmed. This is the brilliant magician, Mr. Sanada Kazumi. I invited him to perform an entertainment number, but I didn't expect his disguise to be discovered before he even began. This young man is truly incredible," Tomoko Suzuki said with admiration.

"Heiji is a very good detective," Kazuha couldn't help but say.

"A detective? I didn't expect you to be a detective as well, Heiji," Tomoko Suzuki said, looking at Heiji with surprise.

Heiji smiled elegantly: "You flatter me, madam."

"Mom, what do you mean 'as well'? Heiji is a famous high school detective from Osaka, he's very good," Sonoko said with pride.

"Oh, really?"

Tomoko looked at her daughter with a slightly profound expression.

At that moment, the magician Sanada Kazumi approached and laughed heartily: "Impressive. Your name is Heiji, right? Truly impressive. I consider my disguise to be quite good, how did you discover the flaw? Could you explain?"

Everyone instantly looked at Heiji. It was true, they hadn't realized that President Suzuki was fake.
