"Exactly, exactly! Hey, you, Heiji, right? You're incredible, haha... Ayako, did you hear that? Someone finally noticed!"

Sonoko hadn't hung up the phone. Hearing Heiji's reasoning, the real Shiro Suzuki burst out laughing, very excited.

Evidently, Shiro Suzuki's words validated Heiji's deduction.

"A person's habits do not change easily. That's why I was sure that Sanada Kazumi was a fake President Suzuki," Heiji concluded.

The hall was silent for a moment, and the next instant it erupted in thunderous applause.

Kazuha watched everything with happiness and said proudly to Ran and Sonoko, "See? My Heiji is the best of all."

"We know. You're so lucky, Kazuha," Ran said with envy.

"That's right. Hold on to him tight, Kazuha, or else I'll take the opportunity to swoop in," Sonoko joked.

Kazuha paid her no mind and smiled happily.

[Damn it, this brat has stolen all the spotlight.]

Kogoro Mouri looked at Heiji with annoyance.

[Hattori's observation skills are truly astonishing. How does he know so many things? He even knows how a fighter walks.]

Conan looked at Heiji in shock, feeling a strong surge of competitiveness.

"A brilliant deduction. Heiji, if you don't mind, after the banquet, you can come to my house whenever you like. I'm sure you and my husband will get along very well."

Instantly, everyone looked at Heiji with envy. Receiving an invitation from Mrs. Suzuki was basically like earning the trust of the Suzuki Corporation. That was an opportunity many dreamed of.

Heiji smiled slightly, but with great sincerity: "Thank you very much for the invitation, madam. If I have the opportunity, I will surely trouble you."

Tomoko Suzuki nodded and returned to the stage.

"Distinguished guests, the impromptu number from a moment ago was ruined by an extraordinary young man. As compensation, how about we ask Heiji to come on stage and give us an impromptu performance?"

"Good idea! That way we can reminisce about our youth, haha~~"

"Hahaha~~ Agreed!"

The audience consisted of high-society people, so naturally they wouldn't make a big fuss. However, some presidents of other large corporations didn't have as many reservations.

Although their financial power was not comparable to the Suzuki Corporation's, they were not to be underestimated either.

"Heiji, go! We want to see you too."

"Yes, I'm really looking forward to Heiji's performance."

"Me too."

The three girls also wanted to see what else Heiji could do. Lately, he seemed to be omnipotent.

"If the lady asks, naturally I cannot refuse. But, may I go backstage for a moment to prepare?"

Heiji's face showed a confident smile, which raised expectations even more.

The policemen quickly put away the note and left, helping the still-sleeping Inspector Nakamori.

They forgot about Conan. He was left alone on the edge of the rooftop, with a frustrated expression: I've been tricked by both the Night Baron and Kaito Kid. April Fool... how did I not notice that word? Damn it!!!

He didn't notice that among the departing policemen, one of them was walking with extraordinary calm.

The large-scale chase that had lasted all night had ended in failure.

"Damn it! All because of the Night Baron's interference. Otherwise, Kaito Kid would have already fallen into the trap. Damn it!!!" roared Inspector Chaki in rage...

"Night Baron, Kaito Kid, I swear I'll arrest you both," suddenly shouted the soundly sleeping Inspector Nakamori in his dreams.

In the dark night market, a figure emerged from an alley. Dressed in a blood-colored tailcoat, it was none other than Heiji.

"To face Conan, you really have to work at it a bit."

Heiji sighed. In reality, he hadn't left at all. Both the fireworks and the smoke bombs were just a show for Conan. Actually, the moment he threw the smoke bombs, he took advantage of the chaos to put on a police uniform and blend in with the crowd.

After all, to deal with a mystery fanatic, the easiest thing is to go along with his own reasoning.

Whoosh~!!!

He suddenly jumped, raising a gust of wind. He glided down the deserted street and, with a push, flew higher and higher.

In the darkness, a silhouette resembling a blood-swallow traced an arc of red light and disappeared into the vast night sky.

"Heiji, get up already!"

Kazuha had come early from her house and was pulling Heiji out of bed.

"My lady, can you let me sleep a little longer?"

Heiji's eyes were full of sleep and he was yawning non-stop. Last night, he had returned to Osaka at two in the morning. It was now six in the morning; he had barely slept four hours.

"No. Today is your mother's birthday, we have to go order the cake and buy the ingredients to cook," Kazuha said nervously.

Heiji opened his eyes, and the sleepiness slowly disappeared. It was true, today was Shizuka Hattori's birthday. Since he had taken her son's place, he could not forget his filial duties.

"Wait for me to get dressed and we'll go."

"Aren't you sleepy anymore, Heiji? If you want, I can go buy things by myself, and you can sleep a little longer," Kazuha said suddenly with tenderness.

"Silly, I just wanted to sleep in, but I can't anymore."

Of course, Heiji was lying. Four hours of sleep was more than enough for him. As an elite operative, once, to assassinate an extremely cautious mob boss, he went two days without sleep before blowing his head off with a single shot.

The night wind danced, making the blood-colored tailcoat flutter slightly.

Heiji was standing silently on the roof of the stairwell enclosure, with a bright crescent moon at his back. His crimson attire reflected glimmers of light, noble and elegant, as mysterious as the starry sky.

"And I was wondering who it was. It turns out to be the great thief, the Night Baron. What are you planning to steal at this hour?"

Kid, feeling a bit embarrassed by his initial surprise, couldn't help but throw a taunt.

Conan frowned: At a moment like this, Kaito Kid still feels like probing the Night Baron.

Heiji looked down at him, like a king looking at Kid: "When evil calls, a gentleman of the night never fails to arrive. You, a white-skinned bird, how could you understand the elegance of a gentleman?"

"White-skinned bird? Hahahaha~~"

Conan looked at Kaito Kid for a moment and suddenly burst out laughing: "That nickname fits him perfectly."

The corner of Kaito Kid's lips twitched, feeling very annoyed. Although he was very smart, after all, he was only seventeen years old, how could he restrain himself so much?

"Hey, Night Baron, with that blood-red clothing of yours, don't you look like a skinned bat? And you have the nerve to criticize me."

Heiji smiled slightly. As for mental fortitude, he could instantly adopt that of a decrepit old man or a naive child. For an assassin, the biggest taboo is to be dominated by emotions.

Although he wasn't an assassin now and didn't need to worry about such things, ingrained habits are not so easy to change.

"A white-skinned bird that hides from the sunlight will never understand the elegance of a gentleman of the night."

"Hahahaha~~!!"

Conan couldn't hold it in anymore. It was the first time he discovered that this Night Baron was also incredibly good at insulting.

The corner of Kaito Kid's lips twitched violently. He looked at the Night Baron who was watching him from above, and his expression changed. The anger vanished in an instant, and he regained his calm: "I suppose the Night Baron hasn't come here just for a battle of insults."

Heiji jumped and landed softly on the ground: "Evil calls to me. Although no evil has occurred tonight, the source of evil has already appeared, and evil will arrive sooner or later."

Kid let out a laugh: "Evil? This is an art that is exhibited before everyone's eyes. As an artist, art in full flight is the most beautiful of all."

"You two, one is a great thief and the other a phantom thief. One stole gold coins, the other jewels, and you still dare to justify yourselves here. Today I'm going to put you both in jail," Conan said, annoyed at being ignored.

Heiji looked at Conan, a malicious smile on his lips: "I've known for a long time that you, little one, are not ordinary. You were even able to decipher my Morse code. I thought I saw you on the bridge that day. Tell me, little brother, who are you?"

[Little brother?]

Conan's face darkened: "My name is Conan Edogawa, and I am a detective."

"Ah, a detective. The encounter is fate. As a gentleman, I will give you both a welcoming gift."

A round, dark green object fell to the ground and rolled to a stop near them.

Kid and Conan stared at it and their faces changed drastically: "A grenade?"

Poof~!!!

A hang glider shot out from Kaito Kid's back. He wanted to save Conan, but the distance was insurmountable. One second later and he would die too.

Whoosh!!!

Kid jumped and shouted to Conan: "Little one, I wish you good luck!"

[It's over, I'm going to die.]

Conan didn't have a hang glider like Kid. He looked at the grenade, bathed in cold sweat, his heart filled with despair.

A huge explosion echoed, especially loud in the silence of the night sky.

"Look, Kid is in the sky!"

The sky lit up completely, and Kid, who was flying with his hang glider, was completely exposed to the sight of the police.

"Damn it. Night Baron, you tricked me!"

Kid gritted his teeth. Normally, it was he who made others dance to his tune, but now, the Night Baron had tricked him.

"Night Baron, this isn't over!"

Kaito Kid's frustrated shout echoed in the night sky.

Conan had not died. He stared dumbfounded at the bright firework in the sky and was left speechless.

The grenade was actually a firework!!!

[Damn it, I almost died of fright.]

Conan was bathed in cold sweat, the clothes on his back soaked.

Heiji shook his head, his tone full of mockery: "You didn't accept a gentleman's welcoming gift, how rude. Little detective, I'll give you another gift."

Swoosh, swoosh~!!!

Ten golden coins flew towards Conan and fell to the ground with a jingle.

"Maple leaf gold coins?" Conan exclaimed, surprised.

Suddenly, a beam of light from a helicopter illuminated Heiji.

"The Baron... the Night Baron."

"Inspector Chaki, it's the Night Baron! The Night Baron has also come!"

The helicopter pilot's voice was transmitted by radio to the entire police system.

"What? The Night Baron has also appeared?" shouted Inspector Nakamori.

"The Night Baron? He's come too?" Inspector Chaki was surprised at first, and then he shouted: "Quick, quick, catch him, don't let him escape!"

"Get up there, quick!" Inspector Nakamori led a group of men towards the rooftop.

The fugitive Kaito Kid sketched a vengeful smile: "Let's see where you go now, Night Baron."

At that moment, a beam of light illuminated him.

"Damn it, they're chasing me again."

He adjusted his hang glider again and fled at full speed to save his life.

But it was obvious that the Night Baron had been exposed because Kaito Kid had lured the police to him. Even though he was fleeing, he wasn't one to swallow affronts in silence.

"Night Baron, this time you won't escape."

Conan crossed his arms. As soon as the Night Baron turned his back, he would use a tranquilizer dart to put him to sleep.

"Escape? Why would I escape?"

Heiji slowly approached Conan, his voice turning cold and sinister.

"What are you planning to do?"

Conan's face changed. He had already activated his tranquilizer watch, but he hoped in his heart: A little closer, a little more and it will be in range.

Da, da, da~!!!

The sound of footsteps was heard. Inspector Nakamori and a group of policemen ran up and surrounded the Night Baron.

"Night Baron, you can't escape!"

"Oh, really?"

Heiji turned around calmly.

[Now!]

Conan, who had not lost sight of the Night Baron, was overjoyed. He aimed his tranquilizer watch at his neck and pressed...

A small, liquid needle that reflected the moonlight shot towards Heiji's neck.

The Night Baron's body suddenly tilted. Poof! The tranquilizer dart lodged directly in Inspector Nakamori, who was approaching at that moment.

"Ugh... so sleepy!!!"

Inspector Nakamori staggered and collapsed.

Conan's face changed drastically.

"Thank you, little one."

A malicious smile formed on Heiji's lips, and his tone had a creepy undertone.

[One moment, system, come out. What does that mean, "time to be determined"?]

At that moment, Kazuha came out of the bathroom, got into bed, and snuggled directly into Heiji's arms: "Heiji, what is 'Phantom Thief 1412'?"

The delicate fragrance excited Heiji's heart. He hugged Kazuha and they lay in silence on the bed.

"Phantom Thief 1412 is just a case file number. He's a phantom thief that gives police all over the world a headache, specializing in stealing jewels. However, that 1412 is not often used. He has a nickname that everyone knows: Kaito Kid."

Kazuha rested her cheek on his chest, with a hint of surprise in her beautiful eyes: "A thief that gives the whole world a headache? Then, are they going to steal Sonoko's family treasure?"

Heiji smiled slightly and, lowering his head, kissed Kazuha's thin lips: "It's possible."

That night was a night of reunion after a brief separation, incredibly moving and suggestive.

"Dad, answer the phone."

However, Kogoro Mouri was sleeping like a log.

"Ran-neechan, I'll get it."

"Thanks, Conan."

Ran was cooking, so she had to ask Conan to answer the phone.

[Conan?]

Heiji was frozen for a moment, but then he understood: "Conan, is Uncle Mouri there?"

[Hattori?]

Conan was also surprised. He looked at Kogoro Mouri, who was snoring beside him, and smiled bitterly: "Uncle is here."

"Then, have him get on the phone, I need to talk to him."

It wasn't even necessary to think to know that Kogoro Mouri either wasn't there, or was drunk and sleeping it off. But he had to say it like that. After all, the one answering the phone was a primary school child, and no one, in the presence of adults, would ask a child to relay a message.

Otherwise, with Conan's deductive ability, he would surely suspect Heiji.

"Uncle is sleeping, I don't dare wake him up."

Conan was scared. If he woke up Kogoro Mouri, he would surely get a beating.

"Then, put Ran on."

"Ran-neechan can't."

Conan felt very annoyed: This guy, Hattori, what a way to say "Ran, Ran," with such familiarity.

Heiji was speechless; he could smell the jealousy through the phone: "Don't joke, little one. I have something important to ask them, about that Phantom Thief 1412."

[Phantom Thief 1412?]

Conan's heart skipped a beat: A simple thief has caught Hattori's attention.

"Heiji-niichan, if you want to ask about the riddle, I know it. The note is on the table."

Of course, Heiji didn't believe Conan's lies; he was one hundred percent sure he had memorized it.

"Oh, really?" Heiji said, with no intention of exposing him. "Little one, do you know how to read?"

[You're the little one.]

Conan's face darkened, but he had no choice but to answer: "Yes."

"Good, then tell Heiji-niichan what it says."

Conan was very annoyed; this body put him at a great disadvantage, but he couldn't do anything: "The first line is in English, I don't know how to read it. A-p-r-i-l, and then f-o-o-l. After that it says: 'When the moon separates the two, I will hear the renown of the Dark Star and, with the invitation of the waves, I will go to receive it.' That's all, Heiji-niichan."

Hearing the busy tone, Conan was speechless: This guy, Hattori...

Heiji hung up the phone and leaned back on the bed, thinking silently about the riddle. Although he remembered many parts of the plot, he had no memory of this particular riddle.

"Oh, Heiji, the signal is gone again."

Kazuha came in from the balcony and snuggled directly into Heiji's arms, pouting with her phone in her hand.

"It's four o'clock. In theory, there shouldn't be an interruption of the BS waves. But, Kazuha, you've been talking on the phone with Sonoko for too long."

Suddenly, a flash of insight shone in Heiji's eyes. He now understood more or less what the riddle meant.

"Heiji, Sonoko wants to invite you to the party the Suzuki Corporation is organizing on the Queen Sallybeth cruise ship. Are you going?" Kazuha said in a low voice.

"The Queen Sallybeth?" a smile formed on Heiji's lips, and he nodded slightly: "Of course I'm going."

"Really? Then, let's leave today!" Kazuha said, impatient.

"Silly, today is only the 1st. The party on the Queen Sallybeth is on the 19th. Why go so early?"

Heiji gave Kazuha a pat on the butt, which caused her to scold him coquettishly.

A blood-red figure was gliding at full speed through the night sky. The full moon was already half-covered.

The wind whistled around him. Heiji had once again transformed into the Night Baron. Since they were of the same guild, it wouldn't be gentlemanly not to stop by to say hello beforehand.

Although the moon was partially covered, the night sky was still very bright.

Conan was running through the streets, his mind working at full speed.

['When the moon separates the two,' those two must be the artificial satellite and the sun. 'Separate' means the moon is between them. When the artificial satellite blocks the moon, creating a brief lunar eclipse, that is, between twelve-thirty and four, the thief will appear. 'Black Star' is the full name of the 'Dark Star.' The first two letters are BS. 'With the invitation of the waves' means he will come with the BS waves. The BS waves are emitted from the south to the west at a forty-five-degree angle, which points to the Haido City Hotel, near the Beika Museum.]

"That's it!"

Conan started running quickly in that direction.

On the rooftop of the Haido City Hotel, the wind was blowing strongly. Conan, standing on the edge, placed the fireworks he was carrying on the ground, ready to launch them and alert the police.

Behind him, a pure white figure descended slowly, with the full moon at his back and his cape fluttering in the wind.

"Well, well, little one, what are you doing here?"

"I was waiting for you, Kaito Kid," Conan said with a cold smile.

"Oh, this little one doesn't seem simple at all. Waiting for me here all by yourself," the thief said with confidence.

"My name is Conan Edogawa, and I am a detective," Conan said with the same confidence.

"Haha, then, little detective, do you know what I'm going to do?"

"What you're going to do no longer matters. You won't escape today."

"Thievery is an art in itself. As an artist, I am going to present you with a work of art in the darkness of the night."

"Many artists become famous after they die. Tonight, let me take you to the tomb of prison."

"Well, it seems it's crowded tonight."

"Who is it?"

Conan and Kaito Kid turned sharply. A blood-red figure was slowly descending. Red cape, red tailcoat, a pale white mask. With his hands in his pockets, he landed silently on the roof of the stairwell enclosure.

The faces of both changed.

Conan arrived on his skateboard and, upon seeing the red car in front of the shed, his face changed drastically: Damn it, I've arrived late.

"It turns out Miss Masami was a bank robber. Did she commit suicide out of remorse?" Ran said with regret.

"She was murdered. At the scene, there were more shell casings than can fit in a magazine. Besides, she didn't die burned, but from gunshots," Conan said with a serious expression.

"It seems a third party has intervened. A dog-eat-dog fight among thieves?" Heiji said, pretending to be confused.

"Thanks for the meal, Ran."

Heiji passed the bowl to Ran and went directly to his room.

In the silence of the night!

A black figure snuck out of the Mouri Detective Agency, gliding swiftly in the darkness like a bat.

Beika District, Third Sector!

Heiji landed directly on the rooftop of a small villa, where Akemi Miyano was sitting in silence.

"Who are you really?"

"You saved me, but I don't know what your objective is," Akemi Miyano said coldly.

"My objective is simple: for you to be my assistant."

"Assistant?"

Akemi Miyano looked at Heiji with surprise: An expert of his level also needs an assistant?

"That's right, assistant. I need a trustworthy assistant whose background I know, and you are the most suitable."

Firstly, Akemi Miyano's ability was good, she could be useful without needing training. Secondly, her sister, Shiho Miyano, was an exceptional talent; saving her was equivalent to earning Shiho's trust. And lastly, she was a great beauty, and an assistant, of course, had to be pleasing to the eye.

"Just because Gin let me go now doesn't mean he will in the future. Do you intend for me to stay in this villa forever?" Akemi Miyano asked, furrowing her delicate eyebrows.

"Well..."

That was also a problem that worried Heiji. If he could get a human skin mask, everything would be much easier.

"Gin will definitely not leave you in peace. For now, stay here for a few days, and we'll see what happens next."

Anyway, for the moment he didn't need that identity to appear. Akemi Miyano could live here for now. He had already bought the villa.

"Do you intend to keep me like a mistress in a golden cage?"

Akemi Miyano suddenly smiled, such a captivating smile.

Heiji's heart skipped a beat. The woman before him had every reason to be proud: a beautiful face, a tall and sexy figure, and an air of refined elegance. She was the prototype of every man's dream woman.

"Don't look at me like that, it's very dangerous."

Akemi Miyano froze for a moment, and then smiled slightly. She didn't know why, but she was suddenly no longer afraid of that person.

"As an assistant, what should I keep in mind?"

"Obey my orders. Without my permission, you cannot reveal yourself, not even if you run into your sister. This is not only for your safety but also for Shiho Miyano's."

Since it concerned Shiho Miyano, Akemi Miyano nodded solemnly.

"Here's five hundred thousand yen, it will last you for a while."

Looking at the wad of bills on the small table, Akemi Miyano suddenly blinked: "Are you really going to keep me?"

Another day passed!

Osaka!

"Heiji, welcome home."

As soon as Heiji crossed the doorstep, a fragrant body pounced on him, soft and sexy, an excellent sensation.

These days, Kazuha had been staying at Heiji's house, and she already considered herself part of the family.

At night, the bed, with Kazuha's delicate fragrance, was very comfortable.

"And now, a breaking news story: the Suzuki Corporation plans to exhibit their family's treasure, the world's largest black pearl, the 'Dark Star', at the Beika Museum. "A-Class Mission activated: Snatch the 'Dark Star' from the hands of Kaito Kid. Time: to be determined."

Thump!!

The sound of an engine starting.

"Hahahaha~"

Vodka couldn't help but laugh out loud.

"And the money?" Gin said with a cold smile.

"Where is my sister? You promised me. If I completed this mission, my sister and I could leave the organization and live the life a normal person should live," Akemi Miyano asked coldly.

"Heh, heh, less talk, where is the money?"

Gin suddenly raised his pistol and aimed at Akemi Miyano, with an extremely sinister expression.

"I don't have the money. If you don't let my sister leave the organization, don't think about getting it," Akemi Miyano pulled a pistol from her clothes and aimed at Gin.

"You underestimate us too much. That one billion yen is in a hotel safe. We already knew that," Vodka said with an air of smugness.

"Akemi Miyano, goodbye."

As Gin's words finished, a shot rang out.

Clank!

The sound of a bullet falling. No, there was another sound.

"A coin?"

Vodka looked stunned at the coin on the ground, flattened by the impact of the bullet.

A flash of surprise crossed Gin's eyes, but it disappeared in an instant. He looked up to one side, where a person dressed in black like them was slowly approaching, playing with some coins in his hand.

Akemi Miyano was paralyzed. For a moment, she thought she was dead. She never imagined that someone could intercept a bullet in mid-air, and even less so with a coin.

"Is it you?"

A cold light shone in Gin's eyes. He had already recognized Heiji as the man in black who had destroyed his base.

"Gin, let's make a deal. You pretend this woman is dead, and I will spare your lives."

Heiji stood in front of Akemi Miyano, protecting her. At the same time, he took the pistol from her hand and looked at Gin indifferently.

"Spare our lives?"

A cold smile formed on Gin's lips.

Bang, bang, bang!!!

The bullets in Gin's magazine ran out, and absolute silence reigned in the shed.

"Big brother, he has blocked all the bullets."

Vodka looked terrified at Heiji and the pistol that was still smoking in his hand.

The next day, as Heiji was going to stay, Kazuha returned first.

When Kazuha spoke on the phone with Shizuka Hattori, the truth slipped out. After finding out about the relationship between them, this future mother-in-law was anxious to see the daughter-in-law that she could see every day.

She had no choice but to return first.

Watching the train depart, Heiji suppressed the tenderness in his heart. Kazuha's reluctant gaze almost softened his heart completely.

"She's already gone, Heiji, stop looking. It's not like you can't see each other again," Sonoko joked by his side.

Heiji looked at Sonoko without words: "Hey, Miss Sonoko, do you plan to marry Ran? You're stuck to her every day, be careful that Kudo doesn't get jealous."

"Pff, that guy, Kudo, has a beauty and doesn't know how to take care of her, he only thinks about deducing all day. Since he doesn't value Ran, then, reluctantly, I will take her for my harem," Sonoko said while hugging Ran and laughing.

"Sonoko, don't joke."

Ran's face blushed slightly. She wasn't used to hugging people in public, not even other girls.

"Well, beauties, I'll leave you alone. I'm leaving first."

Heiji put his hands in his pockets and left with a carefree air.

"How handsome," Sonoko said, smitten.

"That's enough, Sonoko, don't even think about it. Heiji is Kazuha's boyfriend," Ran said righteously.

"Relax, I wouldn't try anything with my best friend's boyfriend."

"Good thing."

Ran didn't realize that Sonoko's gaze towards Heiji was very serious and contained a trace of tenderness.

After separating from the two girls, Heiji went directly to the Shiyou Bank.

After the one-billion-yen robbery, Masami Hirota resigned. Surely he wouldn't find her at the bank, but Heiji's goal was not to find Masami Hirota herself.

With ease, Heiji found out through the bank staff where Masami Hirota lived.

Ring, ring~!!!

Masami Hirota was packing her things when suddenly the phone rang.

"Hello, this is Masami Hirota."

"If you want to know about Shiho Miyano, come to the grove in the nearby park."

"Who are you?"

Beep, beep, beep~~

However, on the other side of the line, only the busy tone could be heard.

Masami Hirota furrowed her delicate eyebrows: The other person's voice is distorted, it can't be Gin. But, why do they know about my sister?

She hung up the phone, took a handbag from a drawer and from it, a pistol...

In the park, Heiji was leaning against a large tree. He wasn't afraid of being discovered; at that moment, not even Sonoko and the others would recognize him if they passed by his side.

Masami Hirota... no, Akemi Miyano, in high boots, entered the grove. She carried a handbag slung over her shoulder and one hand in her pocket as she walked slowly among the trees.

Everything was silent, only the rustle of the leaves moved by the wind could be heard.

"I'm here."

Heiji came out from behind a tree and met Masami Hirota's gaze through several trees.

A flash of surprise crossed Masami Hirota's eyes: This person is only wearing sunglasses and a hat, and it's impossible to see their face, you even forget their appearance in an instant...

This type of disguise is definitely not from an ordinary person.

"It doesn't matter who I am. Akemi Miyano, how about we make a deal?"

Heiji's voice was slightly hoarse and was permeated with a dark aura.

Akemi Miyano's face changed slightly and she tightened the hand she had in her pocket: "How do you know my name?"

Publicly, she had always been called Masami Hirota. Her true identity was an absolute secret; apart from the high-ranking members of the organization, no one else knew it.

"First, take the pistol you have in your hand, lest it goes off."

Heiji knew what Akemi Miyano had in her pocket without needing to look.

Akemi Miyano looked at Heiji in silence, moved a little closer to a tree, and said indifferently: "On the phone you mentioned Shiho Miyano. Are you also from the organization?"

"I'm not carrying any weapons, you don't need to look for a tree to hide behind," Heiji said calmly.

Akemi Miyano ignored Heiji's words and continued to look at him cautiously: "What is your codename in the organization?"

[Codename?]

Heiji froze for a moment, and a malicious smile formed on his lips: "My name is Becherovka."

"Becherovka?" Akemi Miyano frowned.

"Are you thinking that in the organization all the codenames are of alcoholic beverages and that you've never heard mine?"

Akemi Miyano tightened her grip on the pistol in her hand. She didn't know why, but she felt that the person in front of her was even more terrifying than Gin, from the organization.

"Gin sent you to find me, right? Where is my sister?"

The person in front of her was too dangerous; she didn't want to be in front of him for too long.

"Yesterday, when you went out the back door of the bank during lunch hour, you didn't go to eat. You took advantage of your position as an internal employee to have one of the masked robbers put on a bank uniform and invent an excuse for the armored van to stop ahead of time. The van can only be opened from the inside, but since the driver thought it was a bank employee, he took no precautions. The result, obviously, was that they succeeded very easily."

Akemi Miyano's delicate eyebrows furrowed. Those were the details of the armored van robbery.

"Of course, that's not the important thing. The important thing is that, after they left, they left the mask you used to cover your face at the scene. Not only did it have traces of your perfume, but also of your lipstick."

Akemi Miyano's heart lurched. Of course, she hadn't left that there.

"And the lipstick with your fingerprints was also found at the scene of another murder. What do you think that means?" Heiji said calmly.

"Did Gin send you to kill me?"

The signs were so obvious that Akemi Miyano was not a fool. All the evidence indicated that Gin... no, that the organization already wanted to get rid of her.

Heiji shook his head: "Quite the opposite, I've come to save you."

"Save me?" Akemi Miyano smiled coldly. "You are also from the organization. Have you ever seen anyone who has survived after being on the organization's death list?"

Although she was only an external collaborator, the little she knew of the organization was enough to make her despair. Unless the organization let them go, there was no possible escape.

"Yes, there is."

Who says no? That guy, Conan, is an exception.

However, Akemi Miyano misunderstood him.

"Are you a traitor to the organization?"

"Special D-class mission activated: Gain the trust of Akemi Miyano. Time limit: one day."

The mechanical voice of the system sounded without prior warning.

Today the sun was shining brightly. Heiji was strolling alone down the street. Since he was returning to Osaka tomorrow, Kazuha had been forcibly dragged by Ran and Sonoko to go shopping.

"Good thing I escaped in time, otherwise, I would have been stuck being a pack mule again."

Women's shopping stamina had completely terrified him. He preferred to go for a walk on his own.

"System, open the character attribute panel."

As soon as he finished speaking, an attribute panel appeared in front of Heiji.

Evil Points: -99874

As yesterday's C-class mission had been completed, 10 evil points had been eliminated. Everything else remained the same.

Without realizing it, Heiji arrived at the entrance of Shiyou Bank and, after a moment's thought, went inside.

[Kazuha's crystal necklace cost 2 million yen, and Sonoko's and Ran's bracelets, 500,000 yen each. I've spent almost all the money I had on me. It's time to transfer more to this card.]

As it was around noon, there weren't many people in the bank. After taking a number, it wasn't long before his turn came.

"Good morning, sir, how can I help you?"

Heiji looked in surprise at the bank clerk in front of him. An exquisite face, eyes with a hint of melancholy, and a sweet voice.

"Not bad, a 90 out of 100."

"Sir, how can I help you?"

The clerk was clearly very professional. Although Heiji was staring at her, she didn't show much displeasure and maintained a friendly and polite tone.

"Transfer one million yen from my Swiss bank account to this card."

Heiji handed the card to the clerk.

"Alright, please wait a moment."

While the clerk verified the information, Heiji had nothing to do, so he waited, bored.

Soon, once the information was verified, the one million yen was transferred to his account.

"It has been a pleasure to serve you. Do you need to perform any other transaction, sir?"

The clerk returned the bank card to Heiji.

"No, thank you."

Heiji took the card and got ready to leave.

"Little Heiji, what are you doing here?"

Kogoro Mouri looked at Heiji in surprise.

"Kazuha and the others wouldn't let me go with them, so I went out on my own," Heiji said nonchalantly.

[Heh heh, I'm sure this Hattori guy was also afraid of going shopping with Ran and the others.]

Conan looked at Heiji with disdain.

"Conan, have you two also come to run some errands?"

At that moment, the clerk's voice was heard.

"Hello, Masami-neesan," Conan said innocently.

[Wow, what a beauty.]

Kogoro Mouri's typical lecherous expression appeared, and his face changed in an instant: "Hello, my name is Kogoro Mouri, I'm a famous detective."

[Masami?]

Conan's words intrigued Heiji: "Conan, what's that clerk's full name?"

"Does Heiji-niichan want to hit on her too? Aren't you afraid Kazuha-neechan will find out?"

Conan glanced sideways at Heiji and asked him maliciously.

Heiji shot a look at Conan and lifted him into the air: "Do you think I'm going to give you a chance to talk to Kazuha? Stop talking nonsense and tell me now."

"Heiji-niichan, let me go! I'll tell you, I'll tell you! That lady's name is Masami Hirota," Conan suddenly shouted.

"Hmm?" Masami Hirota looked doubtfully at Heiji and Conan: "Conan, do you need something from me?"

"It's Heiji-niichan, he wants your phone number."

Conan seized the opportunity to get revenge.

Heiji casually put Conan aside, walked up to the counter, and looked at Masami Hirota: "Miss Masami Hirota, could you give me your phone number?"

Masami Hirota froze for a moment, and then smiled elegantly.

"You brat, you already have a girlfriend and you're going around flirting," Kogoro Mouri said from the side, annoyed.

"Sir, your daughter is already in high school, stop harassing young women," Heiji said, looking at Kogoro Mouri with contempt.

"Damn high school brat," Kogoro Mouri said through gritted teeth.

Masami Hirota smiled politely: "I'm sorry, sir, but we're not allowed to discuss personal matters during work hours."

Heiji shrugged. Anyway, he had no intention of asking for her number. He just wanted to confirm one thing: Masami Hirota, Akemi Miyano... this must be Shiho Miyano's sister.

"Ah! Where did that beauty go?"

When they came to their senses, Masami Hirota was already gone, prompting a cry of disappointment from Kogoro Mouri.

Heiji and Conan completely ignored this lecherous "famous detective."

"I'm leaving."

Heiji went out the door and turned left.

A muffled gunshot was heard. He knew what had happened, but he didn't feel like getting involved.

He heard the sound of footsteps, turned, and saw Conan's back as he ran. He couldn't help but grimace: This Conan guy, he really has to get involved in every case.

"Dad, Conan, why did you take so long?"

Ran quickly served dinner to Kogoro Mouri and Conan.

"I'm sure the old man took Conan out for a feast," Sonoko said with a smile.

"But, from the looks of Conan, it doesn't seem like it," Kazuha said.

Heiji saw it all as clear as day. Those two were clearly worried about today's one-billion-yen heist.

"Heiji-niichan, what do you think about the one-billion-yen robbery case from today?"

Conan was completely at a loss and wanted to get some suggestions from Heiji.

"The one-billion-yen robbery? When did that happen?"

Heiji pretended to know nothing about the matter. He had his own plans. This would give him a perfect excuse to stay; if he suddenly decided to stay for no reason, it might arouse the suspicions of that mystery fanatic, Conan.

Masami Hirota... no, Akemi Miyano. This woman is very capable. My third identity needs an assistant, and she is the perfect candidate.

Takagi took Kubota away directly, ignoring his screams.

"Young Hattori, thank you very much for this time. I'll treat you to tea later," Inspector Megure said, in a hurry to get back and take a statement.

Satō Miwako looked at Heiji. To be able to find the key to solving the case from small clues... this high school student really was anything but simple.

Heiji and the others were having breakfast. It was their last day in Tokyo.

"It is rumored that the second miss Suzuki bought this museum for a specific person. Is that person your boyfriend?"

Seeing Conan's expression, a malicious smile played on Heiji's lips. I'll let this guy help me complete the mission. He took the note again, stood up, and walked straight towards Director Ochiai.

"Director Ochiai, could I borrow your pen?"

[What is this Hattori guy plotting?], Conan looked at Heiji with doubt.

Director Ochiai's face changed: "Y-yes... of course."

Heiji took Director Ochiai's pen and started scribbling on the paper, suddenly frowning: "Director Ochiai, you won't mind if I keep this pen, right?"

"I don't mind," Director Ochiai said with a smile.

Conan frowned: What is Hattori doing? Has he discovered a clue? Damn it, I can't lose to him.

"Conan, don't run around," Ran told him.

Heiji continued towards Iijima and also took his pen from him.

"My pen? My pen is gone!" Kubota suddenly shouted.

Conan turned sharply in that direction, pricking up his ears.

"Your pen is gone?" Heiji asked calmly.

"Yes, my pen disappeared a while ago," Kubota said.

"Oh, really? And have you taken anyone else's pen?" Heiji asked, waving the two pens in his hand.

"No, I haven't taken the director's or Iijima's pens," Kubota said, waving his hands quickly.

A confident smile appeared on Heiji's lips. He turned and walked to another spot, where there was a pen on the floor, but he didn't pick it up.

[This is...]

Conan's face changed sharply: Don't tell me...

"Heiji-niichan, can you let me see that note?"

Heiji looked at Conan: "What's so interesting about this note?"

"Let me see it, please. I want to be a detective too, a detective!" Conan said in a pleading voice.

"Can't be helped. Here, look."

The note had already been put in a clear plastic bag by Heiji, so gloves weren't needed.

Conan stared at the note for a while and his face changed drastically: I see. That's why Hattori borrowed their pens to scribble on the note. So, the owner of the pen that doesn't write is the murderer?

Da, da, da~~!!

Inspector Megure ran in with Satō Miwako and Takagi.

"Where is the body?"

"Inspector, over there," Director Ochiai pointed towards where Heiji was.

"Hey, you two, this is a crime scene, you can't... Young Hattori? So it was you!",

Inspector Megure exclaimed.

Satō Miwako was about to kick Heiji and the others out when she heard Inspector Megure's words and stopped: "Inspector Megure, they are..."

"Ah, Miwako, let me introduce you. This is Heiji Hattori, a famous high school detective from Kansai. This kid is very good, probably as good as young Kudo," Inspector Megure said with a smile.

"Oh, really?"

Satō Miwako glanced at Heiji, with some disbelief.

"Inspector Megure, you've finally arrived," Heiji nodded to Satō Miwako and walked straight to the inspector.

"Young Hattori, what happened here?"

Inspector Megure approached Manaka's body, his expression grave.

"It's a premeditated murder. The victim is the owner of this museum. When I found the body, he had been dead for about twenty minutes. And I think I already have some evidence."

"Oh, really?"

Hearing Heiji's words, Inspector Megure was delighted.

Heiji nodded confidently: "This time there are two clues: this note is one, and the other is this pen."

"A note and a pen?"

Inspector Megure took the two items and examined them closely.

"Kubota??? This is... Who is Kubota?"

Kubota suddenly shuddered, panic reflected in his eyes: "Why are you saying my name?"

"Arrest him."

"What are you doing? What are you doing?" Kubota resisted violently.

"Stay still!" Takagi pinned him down directly.

"Young Hattori, Kubota is the murderer, right?" Inspector Megure looked at Heiji expectantly.

[That's not right, this could be a setup to frame him.]

A glint of insight flashed in Conan's eyes. He remembered Director Ochiai's strange expression from before.

"It's just a possibility. Inspector Megure, look at the note more carefully."

It's not that easy to fool Conan, I'll have to make it tricky for him.

Inspector Megure stared intently at the note and suddenly had a flash of inspiration: "This is... a pen mark. There's an indentation under the text on this note, what does that mean?"

[Right, the pen mark. Why is there an indentation on that note?]

Conan thought, resting his chin on his hand.

"The answer is over there."

Heiji pointed to an object in the exhibition hall, with an expression of complete confidence.

[This Hattori guy, how he loves to show off.]

Conan looked at Heiji, speechless, and felt even more depressed seeing the admiration in Ran's eyes.

"Actually, a lot of the time it's not necessary to discern the authenticity of things. Just by paying more attention, you can get the answers you want through other means. Who would dare to display a priceless treasure like Van Gogh's Sunflowers in this hall? Besides, if they really had such a treasure, this museum wouldn't be so empty."

"It's true, there are very few people in this museum," Kazuha said, looking at the deserted inner room.

"Let's go to the exhibition hall. I heard there's a lot of medieval armor there, let's go see it!" Ran suggested enthusiastically.

"Armor? Sure, sure!" Sonoko said, also very interested.

"Ran-neechan, I heard the armor in this museum moves on its own at night," Conan said, laughing to himself.

"I... I think... I've... heard that too," Ran said, moving a little closer to Sonoko, feeling a chill.

"Come on, don't be afraid. With Heiji here, he'll protect us," Sonoko said, shaking the crystal bracelet on her left wrist, full of confidence in Heiji.

"If it were really ghosts, there'd be nothing I could do either~~," Heiji said suddenly in a sinister tone.

"Ah~!!!"

It was Heiji's fault for acting so well. That gloomy voice with a touch of terror, almost like a movie sound effect, made the three girls scream in fear instantly. Kazuha, in particular, hugged him tightly.

Heiji and Conan were left speechless.

"Is it really necessary for you three to act like that?"

[Heh heh, and you, Hattori, did you have to do that?], Conan thought with resignation.

Arriving at the exhibition hall, they found it was completely dark, with only a dim light. The dark space looked like a monster about to devour someone, emanating a sinister and spooky atmosphere.

This strange atmosphere made the three girls nervous, and they instinctively moved closer to Heiji.

[Isn't Ran supposed to be a karate champion? How is she so scared?]

Conan had just discovered that Ran was so afraid of ghosts and monsters.

Suddenly, Heiji stopped. His sudden stop caught Sonoko, who was behind him, by surprise, and she crashed right into his back, feeling a soft and curvy contact, a ten out of ten.

Sonoko suddenly cried out and, as a reflex, hugged Heiji tightly.

"Son... Sonoko? What's wrong?" Ran asked, grabbing Sonoko's arm with a trembling voice.

"I-it's nothing."

Sonoko quickly let go of Heiji, her face blushing with embarrassment. Fortunately, in the darkness, Ran didn't notice her strange reaction.

Heiji, of course, felt the pleasant contact on his back, but it was no time for fantasies.

It smelled of blood!!!

At that moment...

"C-class mission activated: Transfer the blame for the murder to Kubota."

[Transfer the blame???]

Heiji was speechless. It seemed that, in the system's eyes, so-called "evil" was whatever it felt like, very whimsical. However, that suited him perfectly. If he always had to act like a saint, that would be truly frustrating.

"Heiji, what happened?" asked Kazuha, who hadn't let go of his arm.

"Someone's been killed."

What???

Everyone shuddered.

"Heiji, don't joke, it's not funny at all," Ran said with a trembling voice.

Drip, drip!!

[The sound of water dripping???]

Conan looked around, confused. No, that's not water dripping, it's blood.

"Kazuha, don't come any closer."

Heiji let go of Kazuha and, frowning, walked over to a spot not far away. It was shrouded in darkness, but under the dim light, it looked like a person was pinned to the wall by something.

Suddenly, a beam of light illuminated the scene, revealing it completely before them.

A fat man was brutally pinned to the wall with a sword. He was covered in blood, and more blood gushed from the hilt of the sword, dripping onto the floor and forming a thick, dark puddle.

The three girls hadn't come closer, but upon seeing the scene, they couldn't help but scream, terror reflected in their eyes.

Thump!!!

Heiji hit Conan on the head.

"Ow, that hurts! What are you doing, Heiji-niichan?" Conan shot Heiji a glare.

"Did I tell you to light up that area?"

Heiji was sometimes left speechless by Conan. When he encountered a case, he sometimes didn't care about the people around him. Although Ran was a karate champion, first and foremost, she was a woman. What woman isn't afraid of dead bodies?

And now he had done the same thing. Knowing full well there was a case there, in order to be the first to see the scene, he used his watch's flashlight function, presenting the terrifying and bloody image to the three girls. This behavior was extremely selfish.

"Buts, what buts! Don't you see the three girls are here? You're very brave, but have you thought about how they feel? They're girls, have you ever seen a girl who isn't scared of these things?"

Conan wanted to retort, but Heiji's words left him stunned. He looked at the terrified expressions of Ran, Sonoko, and Kazuha, and couldn't help but feel a pang of remorse.

Heiji didn't bother with Conan anymore and went straight to the corpse to examine it.

The fatal wound was this stab straight to the heart!

"Kazuha, you three go outside, and while you're at it, call the police."

Kazuha nodded and left with Sonoko and Ran.

It was clear that as soon as Conan came across a case, the reflection from a moment ago went out the window, and he started running around the crime scene.

Heiji easily spotted the note in the owner Manaka's hand. He knew that this note was the decisive evidence.

Da, da, da!!

At that moment, Director Ochiai and Iijima came running in. Seeing the owner Manaka's body, they couldn't help but scream.

"Owner Manaka!!!"

Heiji stopped them, his face serious: "He's already dead. No one can disturb the scene until the police arrive."

"Owner Manaka is dead?" Iijima shouted.

"Young man, who are you?" asked Director Ochiai, relatively calmer.

"My name is Heiji Hattori, I'm a detective."

Director Ochiai's face changed slightly, which caught Conan's attention.

[Why was this director so surprised to hear that Hattori is a detective?]

In this world, there are many things one cannot decide: one's studies, marriage, even waking from a dream... At times, there are also many unavoidable situations, things one doesn't want to do but is forced to.

For example... sleeping in.

"Heiji, let's go visit the art museum."

Heiji felt helpless. First thing in the morning, and without knowing what Sonoko had said to Kazuha, the girl was incredibly enthusiastic about visiting a museum.

"Can't we go later?"

Women are terrifying, he thought. Really, it's barely been a day and she has already fully recovered.

"No, Sonoko says today is the last day the museum is open. If we don't go, we won't be able to go anymore," Kazuha said, kneeling on the bed, pulling on Heiji nonstop.

In the end, Heiji had no choice but to get up.

"Heiji, as a guy, you can't be so lazy in bed."

In the living room, Sonoko and Ran were already up. Seeing him come out yawning, Sonoko shot him a disapproving look.

Heiji looked at Sonoko, speechless: "You're the one to blame. I finally have a winter vacation, more than ten days have passed and I still haven't been able to sleep in even once. Do you think it's easy for me?"

Sonoko, sitting elegantly on the sofa, stretched: "It's rare for you to come to Tokyo, Heiji. It would be a shame to waste it sleeping. I refuse to let you do it!"

"Sonoko~", Ran looked at Heiji apologetically.

"You don't have to be so nice, Ran. Heiji won't get mad, right, Heiji?" Sonoko said with a pitiful expression.

With Sonoko's outgoing personality, probably no one could ever get truly angry with her.

Heiji shrugged and sat on the sofa.

"Heiji, breakfast," Kazuha said, bringing breakfast from the kitchen.

The art museum wasn't far from the agency, so the group decided to walk.

[Damn it, how long is this Hattori guy going to stay?]

Conan felt very frustrated. With Heiji Hattori around, he had to do everything with extreme care, fearing that his sharp-witted peer would discover his secret.

As the saying goes, three women are a show. With Kazuha, Ran, and Sonoko together, the laughter didn't stop the whole way.

"Wow! Is this the museum Sonoko was talking about? It's magnificent," Kazuha exclaimed, looking at the building in the distance.

"It's beautiful, isn't it? Actually, it was Ran who recommended it to me," Sonoko said with pride.

"To be honest, I've wanted to come to this museum for a long time, but I could never find the time," Ran said with some resignation.

"Actually... you wanted to come with that mystery fanatic, Kudo, right? Too bad he doesn't notice anything," Sonoko said with annoyance.

"Well, it doesn't matter. Coming with you all is almost the same," Ran said, forcing a smile.

[Ran~~]

Conan stared at her, his heart filled with guilt.

[An art museum???]

Heiji looked at the building. Don't tell me there's going to be a murder today too?

The museum was huge. The entrance hall was filled with all kinds of paintings, but there were hardly any people.

"Wow, how imposing! And so many works of art," Kazuha said enthusiastically.

"Yes, there's a very artistic atmosphere as soon as you walk in," Sonoko said, pretending to be fascinated.

[Heh heh, does this woman, Sonoko, even know what art is?]

Conan smiled coldly to himself.

"But, why are there so few people?"

Ran looked around. In the entire hall, besides them, there was almost no one else.

"They're probably going to remodel it," Heiji said calmly.

"Heh heh, indeed, it is going to be remodeled. In the near future, these beautiful works will disappear along with this museum," said an old man with a white beard, approaching them with his hands behind his back.

"Really? The works here are so good, why are they closing it?" Kazuha asked with curiosity.

"Because the previous owner's company went bankrupt and sold it to another owner, and this new owner wants to turn it into a hotel," the old man explained with a smile.

"Oh, really? What a shame," Ran said with regret.

"In that case, let's enjoy the visit today so we don't leave with any regrets!" Sonoko said.

Next, the group went from the entrance hall to the inner rooms, where the paintings were more famous.

"Ha, ha! Aren't those Van Gogh's Sunflowers? I didn't expect the museum to have them."

Sonoko, after all, was the daughter of a large conglomerate. Although her personality was carefree, she was by no means an airhead; she just didn't want to show off too much in front of Ran.

After all, if the gap is too large, even the best of friends can grow distant.

"It's true! It's the work of a great painter."

Kazuha and Ran were also amazed.

"But, isn't this a painting worth billions of yen? Why is it just hanging on the wall?" Ran asked, puzzled.

"It's a forgery."

Heiji stepped closer to look at it, a disdainful smile on his lips. In his previous world, he had seen the original; a fake was not enough to excite him.

"A forgery? How do you know? Have you studied Van Gogh's Sunflowers?" asked a museum employee who approached, full of curiosity.

Everyone looked at Heiji in unison; they had the same question.

"It's very simple. Although they've sealed this painting in a square glass case and even forbid getting within two meters of it, if you look closely, it's not hard to see that on the white wall where the Sunflowers hang, there are many paint marks, probably from the frame's paint. The cause of this must be the frequent dusting of the frame. If it were the original, I doubt they would use such poor-quality paint or allow it to be cleaned so roughly. Furthermore, although there are no fingerprints on the case, there are many faint finger marks, surely left when cleaning it with gloves. Judging by these two points, it's a forgery, and a very common one at that," Heiji explained calmly.

"Impressive. This gentleman is truly impressive, he was right about everything."

Instantly, Kazuha, Ran, and Sonoko looked at Heiji with astonishment.

"Heiji looks so handsome when he's deducing," Sonoko said, reverting to her fangirl mode.

Item: Hidden Coin Gun (Permanent Item).

Due to Kazuha's indisposition, she stayed on the third floor and didn't come down to the agency on the second.

"Heiji, you're back."

"If Ran doesn't want it, I won't be so polite!"

"We interrupt for a breaking news story: this morning there was a large explosion in an underground bar. Fortunately, there were no casualties. Next, we will interview the inspector in charge of this operation, Inspector Megure."

"This is a carefully planned, high-intelligence crime. Judging from the traces at the crime scene, not a single clue has been found, which indicates that this is a habitual offender, and a very intelligent one at that," Inspector Megure said seriously.

"Judging from the scene, although everything is charred, there is white powder scattered everywhere. This is all flour, and the explosion was caused by this substance."

To destroy a base, it's not necessary to blow it sky-high. Any secret base, once it attracts attention, is no longer suitable for continued use. That was also the reason the system had determined that he had completed the mission.

After parking the car in a busy area, Heiji bought a set of black clothes similar to those of the Black Organization and put on a long black coat over it. At a glance, he looked like an ordinary office worker.

In Japan, this combination is the standard for office workers, and no one would give him a second glance on the street.

Heiji looked like a normal office worker; at most, he wore a hat that office workers don't usually wear, a simple black fedora. He kept his sunglasses in his pocket and wouldn't take them out for the time being.

However, before going to the Black Organization's base, he needed to prepare one more thing: a bomb!!!

"Boss, I want four large bags of this flour."

"Boss, I want two large bags of this flour."

"Boss, I want one bag of this flour."

Heiji bought a total of seven bags of flour from several shops and, on his way, took a garbage cart that was parked on the street.

It was morning, and winter mornings are especially desolate.

A garbage cart slowly approached from the distance, emitting a particularly piercing screech. A person dressed in a tattered coat was pushing it from behind, their face hidden from view.

Finally, the garbage cart stopped at the entrance of an underground bar. The tattered person took a large bag and went straight inside.

The underground bar was in the first basement level, and to enter, one had to go down a long flight of stairs.

Heiji threw off the tattered coat, revealing a black suit and sunglasses. With every step he took, a surge of killing intent emanated from his body.

Killing intent is the fundamental factor in judging an assassin's strength. The best assassin is not the one with an overwhelming killing intent, but the one who can release and contain it at will. When an assassin can control their aura, the denser it is, the more terrifying their strength will be.

Heiji was slowly releasing the killing intent he had long suppressed. After all, to get close to the Black Organization, he had to be someone from the underworld, and as it happened, that was his old profession.

Gin, who was feigning sleep, snapped his eyes open and stared at the door.

"Everybody up, we have a guest."

Vodka, Chianti, Korn, Tequila, and Calvados woke with a start and looked coldly towards the door, their hearts filled with dread.

[What terrifying killing intent, almost comparable to Gin's.]

Heiji pushed open the door, a large black bag in his hand. He ignored Vodka and the others and walked straight towards Gin.

"I've come to make a deal."

[The voice is disguised, the appearance is concealed. This is an expert.]

That was Gin's first impression upon seeing Heiji in this identity, though he didn't show it.

"We don't make deals with strangers here."

"Oh, really?"

He abruptly dropped the bag in his hand and, at the same time, threw a punch at Gin.

Gin's gaze turned cold. He tilted his head and dodged Heiji's straight punch. At the same time, he tried to grab his arm with a backhand move.

However, Heiji had already anticipated that Gin would react this way. He stopped his straight punch and suddenly twisted his arm, launching a strike from an extremely difficult angle towards the carotid artery in Gin's neck.

Gin's face changed. He pushed hard against the bar and the chair slid quickly backward, narrowly dodging Heiji's attack.

The fight between the two was very sudden. By the time Vodka and the others reacted, it was already over.

Click, clack!!!

Instantly, countless guns were aimed at Heiji. The small underground bar filled with a murderous aura.

"I'll only say this once: I don't like having guns pointed at me."

Heiji's killing intent suddenly intensified, as if carrying a scent of blood that permeated the entire bar.

[How is this possible? This man's killing intent is even more terrifying than Gin's.]

The faces of Chianti and the others changed drastically, and the hands holding the guns stiffened involuntarily.

"Every one of your moves is an assassin's technique. It seems you must be one of the top assassins in the underworld. I wonder who you are."

Gin motioned for Vodka and the others to lower their weapons. The underworld has its own rules. If it's a simple deal, and there's no enmity, you can't use despicable methods to double-cross, unless you can erase all traces.

However, in Gin's opinion, Heiji's current identity was undoubtedly that of a top-tier figure in the underworld. Behind such a person, there was surely a huge organization, and it was not wise to offend them.

"You don't need to worry about who I am. Fifteen thousand Maple Leaf gold coins in exchange for one billion yen, deposited in a Swiss bank. Are you in or not?"

"Maple Leaf gold coins? Are you the Night Baron???", Chianti asked, surprised.

"Don't beat around the bush. If you don't want them, I'll find another buyer," Heiji said, looking at Gin indifferently.

"Damn it, I'm going to kill him." Being ignored did not sit well with Chianti.

"Vodka, prepare the transaction," Gin said suddenly.

"Yes, big bro." Vodka took out a laptop and looked at Heiji.

Heiji walked over and directly entered the Swiss bank account number.

Vodka typed on the computer for a while, his eyes twitched slightly, and then, without leaving a trace, he pressed the enter key.

"Big bro, it's done."

"Transfer received, amount correct," the system's cold voice echoed in his mind.

"There are fifteen thousand coins in total, count them yourselves."

That said, Heiji left the bag full of Maple Leaf gold coins on the bar and turned to leave. Before he left, he glanced at Chianti.

Meeting Heiji's gaze, Chianti's body instantly stiffened, as if she were in a frozen wasteland, and she even found it hard to breathe.

As he was about to reach the door.

Conan smiled bitterly to himself, but he couldn't show it: "Ran-neechan, last night I dreamed of Kamen Rider, and I fought bad guys with him."

"Really... you surely slept poorly because of your dreams," Ran said as she put breakfast on the table and returned to the kitchen: "Kazuha, is it ready yet?"

"Yes, it's ready. Let's have breakfast."

In the last few days, Kazuha's culinary skills had improved by leaps and bounds, and the food she prepared was already quite good.

"Next, breaking news from the police: Officer Miwako Sato, who was kidnapped last night by the great thief, the Night Baron, has returned safe and sound. According to her testimony, the Night Baron simply took her to the place where the maple leaf gold coins were found and then left..."

"That Night Baron again? Why is this guy so famous?" Kogoro Mouri muttered in annoyance.

"Dad, the Night Baron is a great thief who has recently appeared. It's said that he was the one who stole the fifteen thousand maple leaf gold coins," Ran explained.

"What? He stole one billion yen?" Kogoro Mouri was dumbfounded.

[Hey, hey, can this old man stop making a fool of himself?]

Conan no longer had the strength to complain: So sleepy!!!

"Look, that officer is giving an interview!"

Hearing Kazuha, everyone focused their attention back on the television.

"That officer is so beautiful. I didn't know there were such beautiful women in the Police Department," Ran commented.

"Her name is Miwako Sato, she's Inspector Megure's right-hand woman. She's very competent," Heiji said calmly.

"Do you know that officer, Heiji?" Ran asked curiously.

"I don't know her, but I've researched the people in the Police Department," Heiji replied nonchalantly.

"You can access the personnel files of the Police Department, Heiji?" Kogoro Mouri asked, surprised.

Although the personnel information of the Police Department was not a state secret, it was not something an ordinary person could easily consult either.

"Dad, didn't you know? Heiji's father is Heizo Hattori..."

"What? Your father is Heizo Hattori, the Superintendent General of the Osaka Prefectural Police?"

Before Ran could finish, Kogoro Mouri shouted, completely stunned.

[Heh, heh, this old man is just finding out now.]

Conan smiled with bitter resignation.

"And Heiji himself is also amazing," Kazuha said proudly.

Heiji smiled gently, saying nothing.

"Miss Officer, are you saying that the Night Baron's nature is not evil? But he has stolen gold coins worth one billion!"

A reporter's shout on the television once again captured everyone's attention.

Miwako Sato, dressed in the down coat, had a determined expression and a bright gaze: "Night Baron, I hope you will voluntarily turn yourself in to the Police Department. I swear on my badge that I will do everything possible to defend you and get a reduction of your sentence."

Everyone watching the live broadcast fell silent.

Firm and resonant words!

Through the screen, everyone could feel Miwako Sato's sincerity.

"This Officer Sato is amazing," Ran said with admiration. "Yes," Kazuha nodded.

[What happened to this officer last night for her attitude towards the Night Baron to change so much?]

Conan was curious.

Heiji looked strangely at the coat Miwako Sato was wearing: Why didn't she throw that garment away?

A delicate fragrance filled his nostrils, refreshing and intoxicating.

Heiji hugged Miwako Sato tightly.

It was the first time she had hugged a man, and a stranger at that, so Miwako Sato felt very strange in her heart.

"Oh... Miss Miwako, worthy of being the flower of the Police Department, your psychological attack is truly impressive. You almost convinced me to surrender."

Everything Heiji had just said was an act, even the tone of his voice was feigned, but it was so perfect that it deceived Miwako Sato and the others.

After all, it was Miwako Sato who started playing psychological warfare with him, so he couldn't be blamed. He took the opportunity to play along and kidnap her.

Before Miwako Sato could react, she felt a pain in her neck and instantly fainted.

"Officers, when the night calls again, when evil resurfaces, we will meet again."

With that said, Heiji took Miwako Sato in his arms and jumped off the edge of the bridge.

Conan's face changed drastically. He jumped onto the railing and watched the Night Baron gliding over the sea's surface: Damn it, I should have realized this problem sooner.

He had been wondering how the Night Baron had arrived, and it hadn't occurred to him that he might have come flying from the sky, just like Kaito Kid.

"Miwako~~!!"

"Officer Sato~~!!"

The faces of Inspector Megure, Takagi, and the others changed drastically, shouting as they watched Miwako Sato being kidnapped by the Night Baron.

"Notify the coast guard immediately! Top priority to the capture of the Night Baron and, above all, ensure Miwako's safety!"

Beep, beep, beep~~

Countless police cars started up, chasing him frantically along the roads.

At that moment, no one paid any attention to Conan, much less noticed that he had slipped into Inspector Megure's car.

Heiji glided through the night sky with Miwako Sato in his arms. He had to admit that the figure of the Police Department's flower was excellent, well-proportioned, tall, and sexy.

On a winter night, the wind over the sea was sharp and icy.

Heiji was wearing warm clothes, but Miwako Sato, to disguise herself as the Night Baron, was not wearing much. Although she was unconscious, she instinctively clung to him, and her soft, curvy touch gave rise to all sorts of fantasies.

A blood-red figure soared through the night sky and landed on a multi-story building.

If Miwako Sato had been awake, she would surely have recognized the place. It was where she and the Night Baron had first met, and also where the maple leaf gold coins were discovered and stolen.

He left Miwako Sato leaning in a window opening and, seeing her slightly pale lips, decided to pay a visit to a nearby clothing store to commit a little theft. Actually, it wasn't a theft, at least he left a maple leaf gold coin as payment.

Whoosh~~

With a leap, a blood-red figure disappeared into the night sky.

When he returned to the Mouri Detective Agency, it was already past twelve at night. But that guy, Conan, probably wouldn't be back before two.

"Host has completed the D-class special mission. 1 evil point has been deducted. Additionally, please choose a number."

Lying on the bed, a virtual screen suddenly appeared before his eyes, showing a large roulette wheel with the numbers 1 through 9.

[What is this?]

Heiji was a bit puzzled. This system has lotteries too?

"This is the reward for a special mission. The numbers 1 through 9 correspond to an item or a reward of evil points. The items can be permanent or temporary. The evil points vary depending on the level of the mission. It all depends on the host's luck. Next, please choose a number."

It was rare for the system to give an explanation on its own. Although the voice was still cold and emotionless, this time it was pleasant to hear.

[So this is what special missions are. You can even get items. System, can we negotiate something? How about you give me more special missions in the future?]

"Special missions appear randomly, depending on the host's luck."

Heiji shrugged. Anyway, he had only asked for the sake of asking, he didn't expect this cheating system to actually agree.

"Please, host, choose a number."

The system said mechanically.

"Then 6, for good luck."

Heiji chose a number at random. Since he didn't know what he was going to get, he wasn't going to dwell on which number to choose.

On the virtual screen, the number "6" suddenly emitted a dazzling glow and disappeared in an instant.

"Congratulations, host, for obtaining the Hidden Coin Gun."

As soon as the system's voice finished, an incredible-looking gun appeared out of nowhere and landed on him.

[A gun?]

Heiji's face darkened. The design was very elegant and fit the identity of the Night Baron, especially the blood-red glow that completely covered it. But he couldn't carry it with him all the time, what good was it? If someone saw it by accident, wouldn't he be revealing his identity?

"How useless!"

He threw it to the foot of the bed indifferently.

At that moment, as usual, a line of text appeared before his eyes, describing the function of the skill or item.

Item Name: Hidden Coin Gun. Permanent item. Upon binding with the host, it can transform into any object of their choosing. Attention: the transformation can only be performed once and cannot be reversed.

Usage: Can be loaded with coins of any size and fire them as bullets. A magazine can hold ten coins. Range equivalent to a Desert Eagle, power equal to a revolver.

Special Note: When not needed, the item transforms into what the host has chosen to hide itself, becoming ethereal.

After reading the description, Heiji sat up abruptly and carefully took the gun in his hands: "Damn, this is a treasure!"

Being a machinist, how could he not have a weapon?

However, since this world was not like his own, and his identity was different, it was not convenient to carry a weapon, so he had not considered getting one. This hidden coin gun perfectly solved that problem.

"It seems the identity of the Night Baron will appear frequently. Let the gun become a ring."

Instantly, the bright blood-red gun disappeared, and on the ring finger of Heiji's right hand, a blood-red ring appeared. With a thought, the ring became ethereal and disappeared.

He touched his finger, he felt nothing strange, as if there was nothing there.

Heiji was very satisfied. He would test its power when he had time.

The night was already deep. Tonight, he would have a good dream.

[How is this possible? Logically, the Night Baron shouldn't appear.]

Conan stared at the Night Baron in shock. According to his reasoning, in this situation, it was impossible for the Night Baron to fall into the trap. They were on a bridge; if the police blocked both ends, he would have no escape.

"Night Baron, don't move," Miwako Sato drew her gun abruptly and said in a cold voice.

Heiji looked at the person impersonating him; the voice was a little familiar.

"Are you the beautiful lady officer?"

"Hmph, last time you got away by luck, this time I won't let you escape again." Miwako Sato took off her mask, revealing her heroic and charming face.

"So it really is the lady officer. To be admired by you is the greatest honor that can be bestowed upon a gentleman. Allow me to present my highest respects."

Heiji, standing on the railing, gave Miwako Sato a perfectly executed Western gentleman's bow.

"Night Baron, I didn't expect you to actually fall for the trap. Hand over the maple leaf gold coins and that will save you a lot of charges!" Inspector Megure suddenly shouted.

Heiji shook his head and looked at Inspector Megure with disinterest: "A beautiful woman under the moon, what an elegant scene, and you have completely ruined it with your shout."

With a flick of his red-gloved fingers, a maple leaf gold coin suddenly appeared between them. His voice instantly became mysterious and distant.

"Who, after catching a criminal, announces it endlessly on television, as if they were afraid no one would see it? With just a little thought, it's clear that you wanted me to see it to lure me in.
