"If you knew it was a trap, why did you come?" Inspector Megure asked, perplexed.

[Do you think I want to come? I have no choice, all for that measly reward.]

Heiji cursed the system in his mind, but showed no change in his expression: "As I said, being a gentleman of the night, I wouldn't keep you waiting long. Besides, making a beautiful lady officer wait is not befitting of a gentleman."

"You are not a gentleman at all. A gentleman does not engage in theft and misdeeds," Miwako Sato said coldly.

"Theft and misdeeds?"

The corner of Heiji's lips twitched.

"If you are truly a gentleman, then hand over the maple leaf gold coins. I will make sure to ask for clemency for you before the judge," Miwako Sato suddenly said in a soft voice, a tone as sweet as a spring breeze caressing the heart.

Inspector Megure, Takagi, and the others' eyes widened, looking at Miwako Sato in amazement, thinking: Does Miwako (Officer Sato) have such a tender side?

Ever since Miwako Sato joined the Police Department, she had always been resolute and efficient, without any kind of scandal. Although she didn't get too close to the male officers during cases, the impression she gave was that of being like a boy.

Seeing her suddenly so tender had really surprised them.

The scene fell silent for a moment.

[What an incredible police officer.]

Conan looked at Miwako Sato in astonishment. This was an exclusively female and completely unexpected psychological attack: first, a severe criticism, and the next instant, a switch to a persuasion full of tenderness. A normal person would easily break down in an instant.

"You're right, I shouldn't act like this."

Heiji suddenly jumped from the railing, but not towards the inside of the bridge, but towards the narrow outer safety strip, facing the sea...

"I am a speck of dust in society, no one notices me, no one cares about me, I am even despised. I am always crouched in some corner, observing the bright light that emanates from others. I am not resigned. I also want to live in the spotlight, I also want to be the center of attention. That's why I became the Night Baron. The blood-red baron is the most dazzling light in the darkness."

"But, haven't you thought that this kind of life will make you lose your true friends? I'm sure there must be friends who care about you silently. And I am very willing to be your friend, if you want," Miwako Sato said tenderly.

"Is it possible? You are so beautiful, like a star in the darkness, unattainable for a speck of dust."

The Night Baron's voice had a touch of sadness, and even concealed a trace of deep self-pity at the bottom of his tone.

Inspector Megure, with a serious face, waved his hand, signaling the other officers not to move: It seems Miwako has reached his heart.

"A star? When I was ten, my father died arresting a criminal. At that time, I hated him a lot, I hated why he went to save that criminal. Yes, he was hit by a car for saving a guilty person. But... then I understood. My father did it to save that person. The police not only fight crime, but also rescue from crime. Can you... understand me?"

Plop!!!

Two drops of water fell to the ground.

Was it raining?

No!

Miwako Sato was bathed in tears.

[Good chance.]

Seeing that the Night Baron seemed to have been moved, Conan abruptly opened his tranquilizer dart watch, intending to put him to sleep. However... there were no darts left.

[Damn it, I used the tranquilizer dart on Uncle.]

"Miss Officer, may I hug you?" the Night Baron suddenly asked.

There was a commotion among the surrounding police officers, and a look of displeasure appeared in their eyes.

Miwako Sato was the flower of the Police Department, they all secretly desired her. This criminal, who didn't know his place, dared to make such a rude request.

"Don't move, it seems Miwako has softened the Night Baron," Inspector Megure glared at that group of police officers and snapped at them in a low voice.

Miwako Sato froze for a moment, a hint of hesitation arose in her heart. She had never been so close to a man.

[From the Night Baron's tone, it seems he already intends to surrender. I'll take the risk.]

Gathering some courage, she moved her long legs and, with a little shyness in her heart, she approached the Night Baron. In front of him, she holstered her pistol: "From now on, I will be your friend. You will no longer be alone."

After speaking, she spread her arms and hugged the Night Baron.

CRACK!!!!!!!!!!

CRACK!!!!!!

The hearts of the surrounding police officers broke. The goddess had been embraced by a criminal.

The Mouri Agency is located in the Beika district, an area mostly composed of low-rise residences on the outskirts of the metropolis, so there are no skyscrapers.

Although gliding requires jumping from a high place to generate a strong air current to fly, Heiji's "air-control gliding" does not require it. As long as there is an air current, it can be activated. Heiji's body glides freely through the night sky, passing over one house after another.

Every time he is about to descend, he touches the roof of a house with the tips of his toes and rises into the air again, moving at great speed.

On the bridge, Conan is sitting in a taxi, nervously looking at the line of police cars in front of him.

"Little one, why are you following the police cars?" the taxi driver asked curiously.

"The police arrested my dad, I want to see him one last time," Conan said in a pitiful voice.

"What?" the taxi driver was startled. "Why did they arrest your dad?"

"He drank and hit someone, that person spat blood and lay motionless on the ground. Then, the police took him away and won't let me see my dad. I want to see my dad," Conan said, his voice choked with sobs.

A moment of silence for Yusaku Kudo.

[He beat someone until they spat blood? It looks like he's going to be locked up for a long time. I'll grant this child's wish.]

The taxi driver's compassion overflowed; he floored the accelerator and stuck close to the police cars.

Conan lowered his head, pensive. Will Inspector Megure succeed tonight?

In the police car ahead, a person dressed in a blood-red suit and a mask sat silently. Their figure was slender and tall, with legs pressed tightly together, as if they were a little nervous.

"Miwako, it would be better for Takagi to play this fake Night Baron," Inspector Megure said to this "Night Baron."

"Inspector Megure, last time, due to my carelessness, the Night Baron escaped. Please, trust me, this time I will not fail."

This Night Baron was actually Miwako Sato in disguise. It was all a police trap.

Based on Kaito Kid's personality, the top brass of the Tokyo Metropolitan Police Department boldly speculated that this Night Baron must also be a proud and arrogant person, who would not allow his reputation to be slandered, hence this setup.

"It's not that I don't trust you, it's that the Night Baron is too cunning. We still haven't figured out how he escaped last time. You'll be in danger."

"So, if Takagi disguises himself, there will be no danger?"

"Well..."

Miwako Sato's retort left Inspector Megure speechless for a moment, not knowing how to respond. However, in their minds, they had always thought it was much more dangerous for a woman to be captured than for a man.

"Inspector Megure, there's a taxi behind us that has been following us," an officer from the last police car reported over the radio.

Inspector Megure looked in the rearview mirror and, sure enough, there was a car following them.

"Notify the entire convoy to slow down by one kilometer per hour."

The taxi driver noticed that the police cars ahead seemed to have slowed down. If he continued at this speed, he would surely overtake them.

[I don't know where they're taking this kid's father. What do I do if I get ahead and don't know the way?]

"Inspector Megure, the taxi has also slowed down, at more or less the same pace as us."

The officer's voice came over the radio.

"Slow down another kilometer per hour."

"Inspector Megure, the taxi has slowed down again."

After three times, the taxi was still slowing down at the same pace as the police cars, and always by a similar measure.

"Very well, the Night Baron must be inside. Disperse slowly, don't let him suspect anything. Surround him on my signal."

The several slowdowns were to confirm whether the taxi was following them or if it was a coincidence. Three times already proved it was not a coincidence.

Hearing that the Night Baron might be behind them, Miwako Sato felt a pang of doubt: Would the Night Baron really let himself be discovered so easily?

The police cars silently dispersed, slowly surrounding the taxi. By the time the taxi driver realized it, he was already surrounded.

Conan had been lost in his thoughts and hadn't noticed these things; after all, a reduction of one kilometer per hour is hard to notice if you're not paying attention.

Screech~!!!

Suddenly, the taxi braked sharply. Caught by surprise, Conan slammed directly into the passenger seat.

"Ah, that hurts!"

"Night Baron, you won't escape this time!"

Conan was covering his head when a bright light suddenly shone on him, followed by the shouts of the police outside.

[What? The Night Baron has appeared? Where?]

He raised his head and was surprised to see that the bright light seemed to be pointing directly at him, and that a bunch of guns were aimed at them.

"It's... it's not my doing." The taxi driver was terrified.

Miwako Sato took off her mask and, still wearing the blood-red tailcoat, ran towards them, her gun held firmly in her hand, and carefully opened the car door.

A small figure looked at her in surprise...

"Conan! What are you doing here?" Inspector Megure exclaimed, surprised.

"I... Shinichi-niichan asked me to follow Inspector Megure and report the situation to him at all times," Conan said innocently.

"Young Kudo asked you to follow us?"

"Yes, Shinichi-niichan also said that the Night Baron would surely not fall for the trap, because he has no need to come."

"What do you mean, no need? Isn't their reputation the most important thing for those great thieves? Like Kaito Kid, if someone impersonates him, he always appears to unmask the impostor. The Night Baron should be no exception, right?" Inspector Megure said, perplexed.

"Shinichi-niichan says that even if the Night Baron wanted to unmask the police's plan, he would only have to appear somewhere else. There's no need to come knowing it's a trap."

Conan's words left Inspector Megure and the others looking at each other. They had always had the preconceived idea that the Night Baron would act like Kaito Kid. Listening to this child, it seemed that he made a lot of sense and was very reasonable.

Miwako Sato thought the same, but she still felt a little resigned: Damn it, next time I have to arrest him.

"It seems we've worked in vain today," Inspector Megure said with resignation.

"As a gentleman of the night, I will not keep you waiting long."

Suddenly, all the lights focused on the bridge's railing. An upright figure stood silently upon it, the blood-red suit waving in the night wind, and the pale mask gave off a creepy charm.

"The Night Baron!!!"

"The Night Baron has appeared!!!"

His appearance was, indeed, a resounding slap in the face for Conan

Conan was also very excited. He had a feeling that this Night Baron was related to those men in black.

"Are you scared? Silly, if you don't want to, how could I force you?" Heiji thought Kazuha didn't want to do "that."

A smile formed on the corner of his lips, and the gleam in his eyes showed that he had already understood everything.

Night fell!!!

The three of them were having dinner.

"I'm back," Kogoro Mouri said, entering with a strong smell of alcohol.

"Oh, Dad..." Ran said with resignation.

"Ran, is your father always like this?" Kazuha asked curiously.

"Yes, ever since he separated from Mom, he's always been like this. I think it's been ten years already."

"No, they're just separated," Ran shook her head, somewhat resigned.

"I'm sorry, Ran," Kazuha said apologetically.

"Don't worry, they're like that anyway. I'm used to it by now," Ran said nonchalantly.

"Ran-neechan, I'm back."

At that moment, Conan finally returned.

"Conan, where have you been? As soon as you get back, you run off somewhere. you're a very naughty boy," Ran told Conan with a frown.

"I'm sorry, Ran-neechan. I went to play at Professor Agasa's house. He had a new video game console that was a lot of fun, and I lost track of time," Conan said innocently.

"Really, you can't lose track of time even when you're playing. Don't do it again next time."

"Okay."

Kogoro Mouri lay drunk on the agency's sofa, sleeping soundly.

Upstairs, Conan, feeling very lucky, got dressed and left the room.

The living room was dark.

Conan was very cautious around Heiji. His current identity could not be discovered by anyone, but the deductive skills Heiji had shown on the last few occasions had made him tremble. He acted with extreme caution in every move, not daring to be careless in the slightest.

[Phew~~]

Conan sighed in relief: Good thing I didn't wake anyone up.

"This guy, Conan, to prevent Kogoro Mouri from waking up halfway, he even shot him with a tranquilizer dart. He's a pro at getting people into trouble."

As if by magic, he pulled the Night Baron's suit from somewhere. With a quick transformation, a mysterious figure of the night appeared under the moonlight. Looking up at the starry night sky, Heiji, transformed into the Night Baron, took a leap.

A blood-red figure glided through the night sky, like a blood-red bird, crossing the bright full moon.

The next day, the police arrived and arrested Ryoichi Takahashi.

"Heiji-niichan is amazing."

"And Heiji-niichan, wasn't Ryoichi Takahashi afraid that those two mechanisms would fail?"

This was another of the doubts Conan had had all along. Although that type of mechanism was practical, the failure rate was also high.

"I remember that when we arrived, Sonoko said that your sister Ayako's group of classmates meets every two years. I suppose Ryoichi Takahashi must have tried it many times before choosing this method."

"Sonoko..."

Ran nudged Sonoko in the waist: This girl, Sonoko, really... Kazuha is still here.

[I remember Ayako said it, but this guy, Hattori, has even incorporated that phrase into the case...]

"Heiji is very tender with Kazuha. Kazuha, I envy you so much," Sonoko suddenly teased Kazuha.

"That's not true," Kazuha said, blushing, her heart filled with sweetness.

"But, wasn't Mr. Takahashi afraid we would find out? Or that someone might enter or leave through the back door in the meantime, wouldn't that have given him away?"

Ran, a detective's worthy daughter, at least her intelligence had returned to normal.

Heiji smiled confidently: "Have you forgotten the fear the bandaged man instilled in you? Besides, with the rain and thunder, who would be bored enough to go outside?"

In that situation, with the appearance of an extremely terrifying person of unknown intentions, no one would have been bored enough to run outside, much less with rain and thunder.

"So, Mr. Takahashi included all of us in his calculations. What a frightening ability," Ran said, still with some fear.

"Ryoichi Takahashi's feat isn't that big of a deal. This plan of his couldn't have worked without having tried it at least eight or ten times. In my opinion, he planned it for at least one or two years."

It's normal for a plan developed over one or two years to have this kind of result.

Conan nodded: Judging by Ryoichi Takahashi's skill, he must have practiced for a long time, but this guy, Hattori...

"So, Heiji is the most amazing, unmasking Ryoichi Takahashi's plan, which took so long to prepare, at a single glance," Sonoko said with admiration.

Ran looked at Sonoko with doubt: This girl, Sonoko, is too enthusiastic about Heiji.

Kazuha looked at Sonoko with doubt, a little worried in her heart: Could it be that Sonoko has started to like Heiji too?

"I can't, my dad just called for me to come back," Sonoko said with a pout, glancing sideways at Heiji. She would like to stay too.

Although she had acted like a ditz before, she only ever said it as a joke and had never acted on it. Ran didn't even know that she had never held hands with any other boy.

"Kazuha, do you have a cell phone? Let's exchange our contact numbers," Sonoko said, with some idea in mind.

"Yes, yes! Kazuha, I don't think we've exchanged our numbers either," Ran said, suddenly remembering.

[As if they couldn't see each other again. These women are so annoying,] Conan thought impatiently.

"And now for some breaking news: the thief known as the Night Baron, who recently stole fifteen thousand maple leaf gold coins, has been captured by the police. However, the whereabouts of the fifteen thousand maple leaf gold coins remain unknown..."

"Yes, you're right. To throw the puppet out and then retrieve it, you would have to get your body out of the window."

"And it's obvious that with your current build, that's impossible."

"Therefore, Heiji-san's deduction must be incorrect."

"Besides, during the blackout, when the bandaged man came in to kill Ohta and escaped through the back door, I was with all of you the entire time. Isn't that right, everyone?" Takahashi Ryoichi said, scratching his head with an innocent smile.

"Heiji, it's true. When we lit the candles, Takahashi-senpai was right beside us," Ran recalled. "If he were the bandaged man, he couldn't have changed his clothes so quickly."

"And if he had come in from outside, one of us would have noticed."

That's not right. Even without leaving the villa, it's possible to kill someone.

You just need a mechanism... but what kind of mechanism could break the window and then open the door?

Conan lowered his head, deep in thought.

"And what if Takahashi Ryoichi never disguised himself as the bandaged man, but simply killed Ohta Masaru in the dark?" Heiji said calmly. "That way, he would only have to pretend that nothing happened."

"Don't talk nonsense! Let's see, Heiji-san, explain to me how I broke the window from the outside, killed someone, and then opened the back door!"

"During the thunder and lightning, everyone could see that I was with you the whole time!" Takahashi Ryoichi shouted, furious.

"Heiji, I saw it too. Takahashi-senpai was with all of us," Kazuha said in a low voice.

Without realizing it, Conan stopped thinking for himself and began to follow Heiji's line of reasoning.

"A mechanism!!!"

"A mechanism???"

Everyone was perplexed, looking at Heiji in confusion.

"A very simple mechanism. You only need a steel wire, a rope, and a rain-and-wind-proof kerosene lamp."

Takahashi Ryoichi froze, staring at Heiji in horror.

No... impossible. Absolutely impossible. How did this high school student know? My method was flawless.

"Kakutani Hiroki, could you go to the back door and see if there's anything on the outside?"

Kakutani Hiroki approached the back door and examined it closely. His eyes widened.

"There's a deep nail hole!"

"A nail hole? I remember it was perfectly fine in the afternoon," Ayako said, puzzled.

"Because it was nailed in at night. While I was carrying Sonoko to the second floor, there was a whole hour, enough time for him to prepare the mechanism."

Conan's eyes lit up. It was true, at that moment, only he was sitting in the living room, bored.

Wait a minute!!!

"Heiji-niichan, I was in the living room the whole time, and I didn't see Takahashi-san leave."

"He climbed out from his own room. That's why you didn't see him."

Climbed?

The others looked at Takahashi Ryoichi's portly figure with skepticism. Could such a fat man really climb down from the second floor to the first and then back up again?

Takahashi Ryoichi said nothing, just stared at Heiji.

"Heiji-san, I still don't understand what mechanism you're referring to. I don't have the power to duplicate myself, it's impossible for me to have been controlling a mechanism at that moment."

"You didn't need to control it, because it was a simple timed mechanism."

Takahashi Ryoichi's pupils contracted, and panic seized him.

"First, you find a small tree and bend it into the shape of a bow."

"Then, you take a hemp rope. You tie one end to the trunk and pull the other towards the ground, securing it there."

"After that, you drive an iron nail deep into the back door, leaving only a small part outside."

"You tie one end of a steel wire firmly to the tip of the nail and then stretch it in a straight line backwards."

"You walk to the tree you bent and tie the other end of the wire to the trunk, making sure the wire is taut."

"Finally, the most important part: you place a modified kerosene lamp under the hemp rope."

"This way, as soon as the rope burns through, the tree will spring back to its vertical position."

"The enormous force generated will be transmitted through the steel wire to the nail."

"The nail will be instantly ripped out, pulling the back door open."

Silence.

Conan stared at Heiji, astonished. That mechanism... it really could make the back door open by itself. You just had to calculate the time correctly.

"As for the mechanism to break the window, the principle is the same."

"But instead of a tree, a giant slingshot is used. An elastic cord is tied to a tree at one end and to a heavy object at the other."

"When the kerosene lamp burns the hemp rope, the heavy object is launched, crashing into the window."

"Since the cord is retractable, it doesn't leave any trace."

"First, you created a simple device to cause a short circuit."

"Then, right after the window-breaking mechanism was activated, you killed Ohta Masaru."

"You hid the axe and waited for the back-door mechanism to activate."

"Of course, you must have tested this type of mechanism many times before daring to use it."

Conan looked at Heiji, shocked. He wasn't surprised that Heiji knew the principle of the mechanism; it was quite simple and most people would know it.

What amazed him was why Heiji had focused the investigation in that direction.

Everyone assumed the bandaged man was an outsider, and that preconceived notion usually leads to a dead end.

This Hattori guy... how did he figure all this out?

"Heiji-san, I must say, your reasoning is very interesting. However, there's a fatal flaw in it," Takahashi Ryoichi said, lifting his head with an innocent smile.

"The back door was locked. With such a violent pulling force, the lock would have been broken. But, as you can see, the lock is still intact."

"Oh, and what would happen if, when closing the door, this piece of cardboard was placed between the latch and the frame?"

"That way, the door would be securely closed, but not bolted."

Heiji took out the piece of cardboard and threw it in front of Takahashi Ryoichi.

"Besides, it's about time you took out the axe you're carrying in your stomach, you fake fat man."

Takahashi Ryoichi stood motionless. Suddenly, he snapped his head up, his eyes bloodshot, and glared at Heiji.

He reached into his fake stomach, pulled out an axe, and lunged at him.

"I'm going to kill you!"

In the living room. The terror caused by the bandaged man clung to their hearts.

Damn it, what's going on? Why don't any of the clues fit together?

Conan, sitting on the sofa, was so frustrated he felt like he was going crazy. "No, there has to be another clue."

"Conan, where are you going?" Ran tried to stop him.

"The cause of Ikeda Chikako's death has already been determined. She was strangled from behind with something like a cloth and then thrown from the storeroom window in the last room on the second floor, right when Sonoko and I saw it," Heiji said calmly.

"You saw Chikako fall from up there?" Kakutani Hiroki shouted.

"No, what we saw was the bandaged man."

"What? The bandaged man appeared again?" Kakutani Hiroki's face changed drastically.

"What should we do? What if we all just stay in the living room tonight? What if the bandaged man shows up again?" Takahashi Ryoichi said, terrified.

Everyone in the living room?

Heiji smiled coldly. "This Takahashi Ryoichi is very cunning. This way, by morning, he'll have a perfect alibi and can get away with the crime. But this also indicates one thing: this guy probably doesn't plan to kill anymore."

"I'll go get the bedding."

"Ayako, I'll go with you."

Kakutani and Ayako went to get the bedding. That night, everyone planned to stay in the living room.

Heiji went out the back door and walked over to the kitchen window, looking up. The storeroom window wasn't large; it could probably just barely fit Ikeda Chikako's body.

The kitchen window was slightly misaligned with the one in the storeroom on the second floor, so at that moment, he had only been able to hear the noise but didn't see Ikeda Chikako's body fall.

However, there was no doubt that Ikeda Chikako had been thrown from the storeroom by Takahashi Ryoichi; of that, there was no question.

As for the method used to kill Ikeda Chikako, he probably used Atsuko's death to lure her to the storeroom, strangled her with a bandage, and then threw the body.

That method was very simple, and definitely not the C-Rank mission the system required.

The real method that needed to be deciphered was the one Takahashi Ryoichi used to kill Ohta Masaru. That was the most crucial part.

"Heiji-niichan, have you figured something out?"

Conan suddenly poked his head out of the storeroom window.

Heiji glanced at Conan, "What are you being so curious for, kid? Go back to sleep."

Damn it, can't count on this Hattori guy!

Conan started running all over the villa again. He couldn't understand it: why would the bandaged man kill Ohta Masaru and Ikeda Chikako? What was the purpose of a seemingly motiveless murder?

Heiji returned to the back door, and just as he was about to open it, his movements froze.

On the door, there was a nail hole, the size of an iron nail. Judging by the hole, there had previously been something like a nail deeply embedded there.

"Shit."

Heiji cursed under his breath, and a bitter smile formed on his lips. "It seems my IQ has also dropped after 'crossing over.' How did I not notice such a simple mechanism until now?"

Suddenly, he turned around and ran towards the small forest in front of the back door.

After running for about five minutes, Heiji suddenly stopped. Seeing a small tree about a meter and a half tall in front of him, a sharp glint appeared in his eyes. "So this was it."

Tied to the top of the small tree was a long steel wire. At the end of the wire, an iron nail was firmly attached. A little further down the trunk, there was also a rope, not very long, with one end showing signs of being burned.

"There must be another piece of rope somewhere else."

Heiji walked back in the direction of the villa, and after a few steps, a smile spread across his lips.

In a bush, there was not only a piece of rope fixed to the ground but also a windproof kerosene lamp, which was still burning.

"If the back door opened automatically with this mechanism, then the window that broke on its own must have followed a similar principle."

Inside the villa!

"What? You already know who the murderer is and the method he used?" Conan shouted, shocked.

He was still completely confused. How was it possible that this Hattori guy had already figured out who the killer was?

"Hey, kid, sometimes I feel like you don't want me to find the killer," Heiji said, looking at Conan suspiciously.

"Conan, don't bother Heiji-niichan while he's solving the case!"

Ran shot Conan a glare from the sofa.

"Sorry, Ran-neechan."

"No, apologize to Heiji-niichan."

"Sorry, Heiji-niichan."

Conan said reluctantly, feeling very annoyed inside. That girl, Ran!!!

"You said you found the killer? Isn't it the bandaged man? Did you find out where he is?" Kakutani Hiroki asked with pleasant surprise.

"If so, if we all go together, he shouldn't be able to escape," Takahashi Ryoichi said enthusiastically.

Heiji, sitting on the sofa, didn't move.

"I never said the killer was the bandaged man."

Everyone was shocked and looked at Heiji in confusion.

"The killer is you, Takahashi Ryoichi."

Boom!!!

A buzz echoed in everyone's mind, and their faces filled with horror.

"But... but how is that possible? When the bandaged man appeared, I was the first to show up in front of everyone, right behind Kakutani," Takahashi Ryoichi explained hastily, with a mocking smile.

Kakutani Hiroki nodded.

"That's right. The first time the bandaged man appeared, everyone was present. But that was nothing more than a dummy, an illusion created from the storeroom with a hanging string. The purpose was to make us believe, from the start, that the bandaged man was an outsider."

Conan's eyes widened, and he looked at Heiji in amazement. "Right, if that's the case, then many suspicious points fit together." This Hattori guy...

"After doing all that, you put the dummy away and appeared before us, pretending to be surprised. After killing Ikeda Chikako, you repeated the same trick for the purpose of creating another illusion and fabricating an alibi for yourself. Haven't you all noticed that on both occasions, Takahashi Ryoichi was the last to appear?"

With Heiji's words, everyone looked at Takahashi Ryoichi, because it was a fact.

That's right. Once might be a coincidence, but twice isn't. But when did this Hattori guy start suspecting him? No, there's a fatal flaw in this.

Conan suddenly frowned.

"Heiji-san, have you forgotten? The storeroom window isn't very big. To throw a dummy out and then pull it back in, I'd have to lean out. But, look at my build, it's impossible for me to fit through there," Takahashi Ryoichi said with a smile.

Exactly, that's the flaw. Conan thought grimly.

The back door of the villa was the push-to-open type; in short, it opened from the inside out.

As expected, on the dirt path outside, there was also a series of footprints that extended towards the forest to the left of the villa. But that was not Heiji's focus.

He picked up the piece of cardboard from the ground and fitted it into the door's lock. The size was perfect. Then, he slowly closed the door. With a click, the door seemed to be locked.

Heiji stood outside, a sharp glint in his eyes. He didn't need to check to know that the door would open with just a gentle pull. With the cardboard blocking it, the latch didn't fully engage.

But what method did Takahashi Ryoichi use to make the door open by itself?

That was the key to the entire crime method.

He pulled gently, and indeed, the door opened without needing to turn the handle, and the piece of cardboard fell to the ground again.

"Well, that's it, I'm not playing along anymore. That bandaged man must have escaped by now, I'm going to my room to sleep," Ikeda Chikako said in the living room, already impatient.

"Chikako, we still don't know what that bandaged man's target is. It would be better if we stayed in the living room," Kakutani Hiroki advised her.

"Please. Ohta is already dead, and I don't want to die. If the bandaged man comes, isn't it safer to hide in your own room?" Ikeda Chikako said, and headed straight for the second floor.

"Chikako, Chikako!"

Kakutani Hiroki followed her up the stairs.

"Well, I'm very tired too. Can I go to my room?" Takahashi Ryoichi said in his usual good-natured tone.

Heiji had already returned to the living room. He was going to continue investigating, but leaving Kazuha and the other girls alone with Takahashi Ryoichi was not a good idea.

As a mechanic, he was extremely sensitive to killing intent. This Takahashi Ryoichi had already fallen into the path of murder; when he went crazy, he was capable of any inhuman act.

Perhaps, that was the reason he had killed Ohta Masaru.

Conan was still looking for evidence. He didn't know who the killer was, so he couldn't find the key.

"Heiji, did you find any clues?" Kazuha asked in a low voice.

Looking at Takahashi Ryoichi going up the stairs, Heiji shook his head.

"Tonight, Kazuha, Ran, Sonoko, and Ayako, all of you sleep in the same room."

Heiji didn't know if Takahashi Ryoichi would kill Ikeda Chikako, but he didn't care. In his eyes, human life wasn't worth much; he only cared about the people close to him. The others could die in droves, it made no difference to him.

"Heiji, what about you?" Ran asked suddenly.

Conan, who was looking for clues, froze and then looked at Ran strangely, "Why is Ran suddenly asking that?"

"Me? Of course I'll stay in the living room, to watch over the crime scene and prevent the bandaged man from reappearing."

The mission ended that night, Heiji couldn't relax.

The key to the method is in the window and the back door.

What mechanism did Takahashi Ryoichi use to make the window break on its own and the door open by itself?

And the most important thing is that he didn't leave the slightest trace at the scene.

"Heiji, I want to stay here with you."

Heiji came out of his thoughts and looked at Kazuha.

"When I'm with Heiji, that's when I feel safest."

Kazuha snuggled into Heiji's lap with her long legs, her face full of love.

"Heiji, Sonoko and I will stay too," Ran said in a low voice.

Sonoko, in her arms, nodded. At that moment, they felt that being near Heiji was the safest. It was a feeling of trust.

There was no choice but to bring some blankets for the three girls to sleep on the sofa. Luckily, the sofa was large, and they could sleep leaning on each other.

Ayako wasn't too scared and went to her own room.

It was still raining outside, with the sound of thunder and the occasional flash of lightning.

Luckily, Ohta Masaru's body was in the dining room. Although the dining room and the living room were connected, they were in different directions. The living room faced the main entrance, where there were no trees, but the dining room was on the side, next to a small forest.

That's why the others thought the bandaged man had entered from the small grove by breaking the window, killed Ohta Masaru under the cover of darkness, and then escaped through the back door, disappearing into the forest.

Heiji was sitting on the sofa, with Kazuha resting peacefully on his lap. Beside them were Ran and Sonoko.

This guy, Hattori.

Conan was very annoyed. Why did he have to sit alone?

Time passed!!!

After about an hour, everyone was half asleep.

Heiji wasn't sleeping. He kept thinking about Takahashi Ryoichi's method.

Making the window break and the door open by themselves is like using a remote control. Remote control...

He felt he had the key within his grasp, but he couldn't quite catch that fleeting idea.

At that moment, Sonoko suddenly woke up, "Heiji, you're not sleeping?"

"No. You go back to sleep."

"I'm thirsty, I'm going to the kitchen for a glass of water."

It was well known that a fever and a cold make you very thirsty, and your throat feels like it's on fire. Besides, your body feels weak and without strength. So, in the end, Heiji had to help her get water and, while at it, go to the bathroom.

Suddenly, there was a loud noise of something falling outside the kitchen window.

Sonoko, who was drinking water, lunged at Heiji, hugging him tightly and screaming in terror.

A cold light flashed in Heiji's eyes, because he saw it too: the bandaged man flashing past the window like lightning.

"Sonoko, what happened?"

Ran and Kazuha ran over, just in time to see Heiji hugging Sonoko.

"The bandaged man appeared again!" Sonoko said, terrified.

Kakutani Hiroki, Takahashi Ryoichi, and Suzuki Ayako came running down instantly.

"And Chikako-neechan?" Conan realized someone was missing.

A flash of insight shone in Heiji's eyes, "Ran, I'm leaving Sonoko with you."

After putting Sonoko in Ran's arms, he ran towards the back door and out to the area behind the kitchen.

And sure enough!!!

Ikeda Chikako's body lay silently on the ground. Her eyes were wide open, and a bruised mark on her neck was terribly visible.

"Heiji, what happened?" Kazuha asked through the window.

"Ikeda Chikako is dead."

Conan's face changed drastically, and he ran out after him.

Two people murdered in such a short time. A dark cloud of terror hung over everyone's hearts.

Heiji remained still in his spot, with Kazuha clinging to him tightly.

"Don't move, don't contaminate the scene!"

Conan kept shouting at the top of his lungs, but in reality, no one listened to a child.

The system's voice suddenly sounded and then quickly fell silent.

Heiji's face darkened. "Fuck you, system! Couldn't you just ask me to name the killer? But no, this tricky system asks me to find the crime method, just to not leave me in peace."

A case worthy of being classified as C-Rank was no longer one that could be solved at a glance.

The villa remained in chaos.

"Everyone stay where you are and don't move!"

"Nobody move."

Tick-tock! Tick-tock!

However!

Now, to the important part.

That type of axe was not very heavy.

Heiji could state with certainty that the axe must have been hidden in Takahashi Ryoichi's fake belly.

But, what a pain. This mission wasn't to find the killer, but to decipher the crime method. What was puzzling was why Ohta Masaru was killed and not Ikeda Chikako.

That was a suspicious point!

Near Ohta Masaru's body, there were no other traces, no raindrops or anything of the sort.

Conan was not amused that that woman, Sonoko, was tempting Ran.

"Ran, are you going to look kindly on a bunch of college students getting this poor sick girl drunk? If something happened, what would I do?" Suzuki Sonoko said in a plaintive voice.

"But..." Ran looked at Heiji, and suddenly her beautiful eyes lit up with an idea: "Sonoko, I can go, but I'd like to bring two people with me, is that okay?"

"Sis Ran, I want to go too, I want to go too!"

Conan shouted from the sofa, feeling incredibly frustrated inside: "That girl, Ran! She ignored me completely!"

"You mean that Heiji fellow and Kazuha? If it's those two, they can come. But that brat Conan, no way. This is an adult gathering; what would a brat be doing getting involved in these things?"

Suzuki Sonoko's voice was very loud, and Conan, who heard it, wore a sullen expression: "That Sonoko!!!!".

"No way. I don't trust leaving Conan home alone," Ran said, in a bind.

"And isn't your detective father home?" Suzuki Sonoko asked with curiosity.

"If my father can take care of himself, we can consider ourselves lucky."

Talking about Mouri Kogoro filled Ran with frustration, and she couldn't help but sigh.

"You're right, that lecherous old man is not to be trusted. Well then, this young lady, in an act of great mercy, will allow that brat Conan to come."

"Really? Thanks, Sonoko!"

"Why are you thanking me? With the relationship we have, is it necessary to be so formal?"

"Yes, I understand."

"If that's the case, I'll come pick you up this afternoon by car. Don't let me down!"

Hearing the end-of-call tone, Ran smiled slightly.

It was undeniable that Suzuki Sonoko's feelings for Ran were sincere and pure, a perfect best-friend relationship.

Heiji was reading the newspaper when, suddenly, a delicate and elegant fragrance reached his nose. Ran was standing by his side.

"Heiji, do you and Kazuha have any plans for today? A good friend of mine, the one who called, wants to invite us to her sister's alumni reunion. I was wondering if you'd like to go."

"Alumni reunion? Where?"

Today's plan was to go try Tokyo snacks. If he could eat and drink for free, mmm, that wouldn't be bad at all.

"At a villa. I heard they've prepared a lot of delicious food, but we'll have to stay overnight."

"Ask Kazuha. If she wants to, I have no problem."

Anyway, there were no cases in sight and he had plenty of free time, so he had no objections.

Seeing Ran's back as she headed to the kitchen, Conan felt very upset: "That girl, Ran! She completely ignored me."

!!!Ring, ring, ring!!!

The phone rang again. Heiji looked toward the kitchen and stood up to answer.

"Brother Heiji, I'll answer!"

Conan needed to assert his presence, or they'd end up forgetting him.

[Why is a child answering?]

A question crossed Inspector Megure's mind: "Hello, this is Inspector Megure of the Metropolitan Police. Is Edogawa Conan there, please?"

[Are they looking for me?]

Conan gripped the receiver tightly and turned so Heiji couldn't see his expression: "I'm Edogawa Conan. Do you need anything, officer?"

"Ah, so it's you, Conan. I'm a good friend of your brother Shinichi. I have an urgent matter to discuss with him; can you let him know?"

When mentioning the name Kudo Shinichi, Inspector Megure deliberately lowered his voice so Satou Miwako and the others wouldn't hear.

Conan felt helpless. Although he could change his voice, it was impossible to do so in front of Heiji.

"Shinichi isn't here. Give me his number and I'll send him a message."

"Alright, goodbye, officer."

After hanging up, Conan looked at the number in his hand and thought, "It must be about last night."

"Heiji, tell Ran I'm going to Professor Agasa's to use the computer and that I won't be back for lunch."

Hearing Conan's footsteps receding, a malicious smile appeared on Heiji's lips. It didn't take a genius to know it was about the Night Baron matter. But no matter how much they investigated, they wouldn't find the slightest trace.

The system was not something to be taken lightly.

"Time to eat!"

Kazuha came out wearing an apron, holding a plate: "Heiji, time to eat."

"Sure." Heiji stood up and, upon seeing the plate in Kazuha's hands, was stunned: "Kazuha, what is this?"

"Chicken cutlets. Isn't it your favorite food, Heiji? I made them especially for you," Kazuha said enthusiastically.

[Are these chicken cutlets?]

Heiji looked incredulously at the two pieces black as coal on the plate. If he made an effort, he could smell the strong burnt odor.

At that moment, Ran also came out wearing an apron, holding two plates. Coincidentally, one of them was also chicken cutlets, and Heiji recognized them at once.

Looking at the two plates with the same ingredient, it was like having a dazzling beauty and a horror before him; one side was paradise, the other was hell.

"Heiji, did I do it wrong?" Kazuha said, somewhat discouraged.

"Don't worry, it's everyone's first time. Next time it'll come out much better," Heiji comforted her.

"That's right. Kazuha worked hard. Next time you'll surely improve. Cheer up!" Ran encouraged her.

"Yes." Kazuha pulled herself together and put the two "chicken cutlets" into Heiji's bowl, looking at him expectantly: "Heiji, try them."

Time passed in the bathroom.

Beep, beep!~~

At dusk, Suzuki Sonoko arrived at the agency in a BMW.

"Ran, are you ready? It's time to go!"

"I'm coming, I'm coming!" Ran replied from the window, then looked at Heiji: "Heiji, are you really okay?"

"Don't worry, let's go."

Heiji pulled along a guilty Kazuha and followed her, vowing to himself that he would never again in his life eat chicken cutlets.

The next day, the case of the great thief Night Baron escalated even more, and the police couldn't contain it.

"Metropolitan Police Department!"

Inspector Megure slammed his fist on the table, his round, chubby body trembling. "Damn it! The Italian embassy has called and demanded that we hand Cabana over to them immediately and let them take charge of this case.

"What? But, Inspector Megure, is it possible that this Night Baron is a member of that Italian gang of thieves?" Satou Miwako asked skeptically.

"I don't think that's possible either. Although Night Baron's voice was altered, it was definitely a Japanese accent. In other words, it's impossible for Night Baron to be Italian," Inspector Megure said seriously.

"But our superiors have ordered us to hand over Cabana, and he's our only lead. Why did Night Baron know where the Maple Leaf gold coins were?" Takagi asked from the side, confused.

Satou Miwako furrowed her beautiful brows and suddenly remembered something. "Inspector Megure, how did you find out the Maple Leaf gold coins were there?"

Inspector Megure was puzzled for a moment, then slapped his forehead. "Ah, that's right! I remember now, it was...

"Inspector Megure, please don't reveal that it was me who told you. I'm investigating a very important matter and it's not convenient for me to show up. If you need me, call the Mouri Detective Agency and ask a boy named Edogawa Conan to tell you."

If he hadn't suddenly remembered Kudo's words, Inspector Megure almost let it slip.

Satou Miwako, Takagi and the others looked at Inspector Megure strangely. "Inspector Megure? Inspector Megure?

"Ah, it was young Mouri who told me."

Satou Miwako and Takagi were stunned. Inspector Megure was acting a little odd today.

Mouri Detective Agency.

"Ring, ring, ring!!!"

"Heiji, can you answer the phone, please?"

Ran was teaching Kazuha how to cook.

"Sure, no problem."

Conan fell silent at the side. "But what's going on? That girl Ran is ignoring me? Why is she asking Hattori to answer the phone?"

He didn't stop to think that he was now Edogawa Conan, not Kudo Shinichi. Who would ask an elementary school boy to pick up the phone?

"Yes, Mouri Detective Agency speaking."

"Hey, who is this? You're not a thief, are you?"

A clear but slightly hoarse voice came down the line, with a tone full of suspicion.

Heiji wore a sullen expression. "Your voice has a strong nasal tone, and you also pant a bit when you speak. It's obvious you're breathing through your mouth. And if you're panting while talking on the phone, either you're doing some kind of exercise or you have a cold. I wonder if I'm right, miss."

On the other end of the line, Suzuki Sonoko had a sullen look, barely containing her anger. "Are you Kudo?"

"No," Heiji replied dryly.

"You're not Kudo? Then what are you doing at Ran's house? Don't tell me... are you Ran's new love?"

Suddenly, a shrill noise came from the other end of the line that made Suzuki Sonoko's ears hurt.

"Ran, it's for you."

Heiji already knew who was on the other end. With just a little thought, he knew it was that superficial girl, Suzuki Sonoko. He had no desire to waste time with her and just left the phone on the table.

"Thanks, Heiji." Ran left the kitchen and picked up the phone. "Hello, this is Mouri Ran."

"Ran! Are you hiding something from me? Do you have a new boyfriend and you didn't tell me? What a terrible friend you are!"

As soon as Ran picked up the phone, she heard Suzuki Sonoko's yelling.

[New boyfriend??]

Conan, who had been lying lazily on the sofa, sat up abruptly, straining to listen.

"New boyfriend? Sonoko, what are you talking about?" Ran asked, confused.

"Ran, don't pretend. But you do like detectives, right? Isn't it because of that guy, Kudo? Hasn't Ran still not forgotten Kudo? For God's sake! Don't tell me you're trying to play both sides. Don't worry, I'll keep your secret."

On the other end of the phone, Suzuki Sonoko kept talking, completely absorbed in her own conjectures.

"Sonoko, if you keep talking nonsense, I won't pay any attention to you," Ran said angrily.

"Okay, okay, it was a joke. Everyone knows you like that deduction fanatic, Kudo. But Ran, has Kudo come back yet?"

Hearing Ran get upset, Suzuki Sonoko quickly apologized.

"Shinichi? No, he hasn't come back," Ran replied, surprised.

"Then who was the guy on the phone earlier? Just by hearing my voice and my breathing, he knew I had a cold. If it's not that deduction fanatic, who else could it be?"

"Ah, Sonoko, you mean Heiji. He's like Shinichi, a high school detective, and he's also very good at deducing."

[Oh my, that girl Sonoko! How can she mistake Hattori for Ran's boyfriend! It's incredible!]

Conan was speechless.

"Heiji?" Suzuki Sonoko seemed to discover a new world. "Ran, is that Heiji handsome?"

The phone volume was very high, and Conan heard everything clearly. He was speechless again. "How superficial Sonoko is."

"Mmm~ he's very handsome," Ran said honestly after thinking for a moment.

[That girl, Ran!]

Conan glanced at Ran, feeling a little jealous.

"Really? Do you think I have any chance?" Suzuki Sonoko asked, very excited.

"Enough. Heiji has a girlfriend, and Kazuha is also very beautiful. You don't stand a chance," Ran said, who knew her friend's personality well, with a tone of annoyance.

"So what if he has a girlfriend? I, Suzuki Sonoko, am not bad either. Hehehe!"

Suzuki Sonoko's narcissistic laugh came through the phone.

Heiji, who had been sitting on the sofa the whole time, wore a sullen expression.

It was undeniable that Suzuki Sonoko was not only pretty, but her figure could be compared to Kazuha's, and she was also a super-rich heir. But her personality — a mix of superficiality and narcissism — was truly unbearable.

Ran also felt helpless and looked at Heiji with an apologetic air.

Heiji shrugged, indicating he didn't mind.

"Well, seriously, Sonoko, why did you call me?"

Ran steered the conversation back on track by force. Otherwise, that woman was capable of rambling on until she planned which school her future children would attend.

"Ah, I remember now. Ran, my sister is organizing a reunion, do you want to come?"

Only Kazuha and Ran were at the agency. Mouri Kogoro seemed to have some matter to attend to and was not there.

Kazuha ate absentmindedly, glancing toward the door from time to time with a bored expression.

""This channel brings you breaking news. Tonight, the police received a tip and found the fifteen thousand Maple Leaf gold coins stolen by the group of Italian thieves. However, according to an informed source, an unexpected intruder appeared in the middle of the operation. This is his photograph...""

Suddenly, a picture of Night Baron appeared on the television. In his blood-red tailcoat, his slender figure stood upright in the window recess, a pale mask framed by the cape, and behind him a full, radiant moon.

"Wow, Night Baron even looks cooler than Kaito Kid!

In a luxurious mansion, a beautiful young girl covered her face as she watched the television with delight, her long pale legs crossed and an expression of complete adoration.

Ekoda City!

"Young master, I think I've seen that person's image somewhere," said an elderly man at the side, respectfully, who seemed to be Jii Kounosuke.

A high school student who resembled Kudo Shinichi, with great heartbreaker potential, watched the TV with a sneering smile: "He's just a flashy clown. And those cops are idiots. That so-called Night Baron surely didn't leave; he hid the coins on the roof and then used paper with a texture similar to the roof to camouflage them. That's how he fooled them all."

"Ah, I remember now, young master. That Night Baron is a character from a novel by Yusaku Kudo, only his clothes are blood-colored."

Kuroba Kaito grimaced. It seemed his butler hadn't paid him the slightest attention. But, in his view, this Night Baron wasn't all that; he could only fool those stupid policemen.

Across the street, Nakamori Ginzo ground his teeth in anger.

The table trembled violently.

"Damn it! Do all these thieves ignore the authority of the police? First Kaito Kid, and now a great thief appears, Night Baron. Bastards, bastards!"

A slender girl looked at her father resignedly: "Dad, it's because they've never caught Kaito Kid. If they had, these thieves wouldn't be so brazen."

"What are you saying? Just wait — next time I'll catch Kaito Kid!"

In an apartment in Beika City, Sato Miwako lay in bed, weak. She was still turning over in her mind the fact that she had been taken hostage by Night Baron.

"Next time, I won't let you get away."

In a luxury apartment in Beika City.

"What is wrong with this society? If they're not phantom thieves, they're great thieves. I wonder how Ran is... But, on the other hand, that guy's business should improve a bit because of this, right?"

A young, tall, mature woman sat calmly on the sofa, her long, slender legs crossed and swinging, watching the TV with a relaxed air.

In a subway car in Beika City, Conan pinched his chin, lost in thought: "Impossible. There was nowhere to hide in the attic. I looked closely and there wasn't any corner that could be camouflaged. That Night Baron must have jumped off the building, but why isn't there the slightest trace? In theory, from the flash of light until we recovered our vision, only about ten seconds passed. It's impossible to erase all traces in such a short time. And besides, why would he erase all the traces?"

"Ah, ah, ah, I have no idea!"

Suddenly, everyone in the car turned to look at him.

In any case, Night Baron's appearance was like throwing a small stone into a calm lake: the sound wasn't loud, but it still caused wave after wave.

"I'm back."

Heiji entered carrying two bags.

Suddenly, the sound of hurried footsteps was heard and, accompanied by a rush of fragrance, a figure hurled herself into his arms.

"Heiji, where have you been? Why are you back so late?"

Sensing the familiar scent in his arms, Heiji smiled fondly and handed one of the bags to the teary-eyed girl: "Look, what is this?"

Kazuha wiped her tears, took the bag, and when she looked inside her beautiful eyes sparkled with joy: "Heiji, how did you know I liked this dress? And you bought the scarf too."

"Of course. I'm the great detective Hattori Heiji, and observation is my strong point. When we passed that shop you looked at this dress three times. The first time could have been curiosity, the second to look a little closer, so the third had to mean you liked it. And as for this scarf, no need to say more, right?" Heiji said confidently.

Muah!

"Thanks, Heiji."

Kazuha was completely moved, not by the gift, but because Heiji had noticed her. That proved she was very important to her boyfriend.

"Dummy, you're my girlfriend. It's natural to give gifts to your girlfriend, you don't have to thank me," Heiji said, giving Kazuha a playful pat on the butt.

Ran stood to one side with a slight smile, full of envy: "Kazuha, you're so happy."

"Oh, come on! Ran, you're teasing me again," Kazuha said with a happy smile. Suddenly she saw that Heiji still had another bag in his hand and asked curiously: "Heiji, is that bag clothes too?"

"Ah, this is a scarf." Heiji released Kazuha's waist and approached Ran. "This is for Ran, as thanks for having us over."

Ran was startled and waved her hands quickly: "No, it's not necessary, Heiji. You're too kind."

"Ran, accept it. If you're afraid Kudo will get jealous, I'll explain it to him," Kazuha said, slipping the bag into Ran's hands mischievously.

"Well... then thank you, Heiji and Kazuha," Ran said, grabbing the bag and thanking them.

Conan returned an hour and a half later and, of course, received a good scolding from Ran.

Night fell!

In Ran's room, everything was dark. However, she wasn't sleeping; her expression was somewhat gloomy.

Looking at the bag at the foot of the window, she had tried on the scarf. It suited her very well, it was very pretty, but it was a pity it wasn't a gift from Shinichi.

"Now that I think about it, Shinichi has never given me anything."

As for Heiji...

After a whole day out, Kazuha was exhausted and fell fast asleep in his arms, and he could do nothing about it.

Just as the handcuffs were about to close around Heiji's wrist...

The hand that had been clenched into a fist suddenly opened, and a blinding flash shot into Sato's eyes, making her blink instinctively.

At that moment, Heiji turned his wrist. The handcuffs that were about to clamp on him snapped shut in an instant around Sato's wrists. At the same time, he spun her around and pinned her hands behind her back.

All these movements were completed in the blink of an eye, managing to take the Metropolitan Police Department's beauty hostage.

Clack, clack!

Two glowing spheres hit the floor with a dull thud.

"Glow balls?"

Sato's face changed. She couldn't believe she'd been fooled by two simple glow balls.

"What do you think you're doing? Let go of Miwako right now!"

Inspector Megure and the others drew their guns and trained them on Heiji, their faces taut with tension.

"Taking me hostage will only make your crime worse. If you surrender now, I can ask the judge not to charge you with assaulting an officer."

Though immobilized, Sato Miwako didn't panic and tried to persuade Heiji with words to give himself up.

Too bad that tactic probably wouldn't even work on a three-year-old.

"My lovely officer, taking a lady hostage is not what a gentleman does. I assure you, this is the first and last time."

Heiji held Sato Miwako's hands behind her back so she couldn't move. This woman was an expert in martial arts; she couldn't be underestimated.

"Who are you and why are you here?"

Sato Miwako, of course, wasn't going to believe a criminal's words, but she also planned to extract information from him.

"Who am I? Mmm, let me think... Right, you can call me Night Baron, the knight of darkness. As for why I'm here, it's because I was the one who told you where the treasure was hidden."

"Was it really you who called?" Conan asked nervously from the side.

"Well, so it was you, kid, who cracked my code. Tsk, tsk, not bad," said Heiji, feigning surprise.

[!!!Damn it!!!]

Conan's face changed. Fortunately, Inspector Megure and the others didn't understand what they were talking about.

"Whose child is this? Take him away from here, he's dangerous."

Inspector Megure signaled to Takagi to take Conan away.

"Night Baron? Lying is not fitting for a gentleman."

Sato Miwako had never heard that name before, so she assumed Heiji had made it up.

And indeed, it was a name Heiji had pulled out of thin air, inspired by a novel by Kudo Yusaku. After all, it was only a nickname; it didn't matter.

"Believe it or not, suit yourselves. Mmm, it's almost time. My lovely officer, although I'd love to spend a passionate night with you, unfortunately, there's no time."

Heiji looked at the glow balls on the floor, and a malicious smile spread across his lips.

"3" "2" "1"

Before Inspector Megure and the others could react...

The spheres on the floor exploded with a "boom." A bright light flashed in the attic, and everyone instinctively shut their eyes.

At the same time, there was a loud thud against the outer wall.

"Inspector Megure, that... Night Baron has escaped."

Sato Miwako was the first to react, realizing her handcuffs were open.

"The coins! All the Gold Maple Leaf coins are gone!"

It took a while for everyone's vision to return. However, the sacks of Gold Maple Leaf coins that had been on the floor had vanished without a trace.

"I just heard a noise outside, against the wall. That... Night Baron must have escaped with the coins!" someone shouted from the crowd.

"Damn! The sound just now must have been the coins hitting the wall. But this place is five stories high and there's no rope nearby—how could he have escaped?"

Conan peered out through the window gap to look, but he didn't see the slightest sign that a rope had been used. His face darkened.

"Did he really escape this way?"

Sato Miwako wondered aloud, sharing the same doubt as Conan.

Inspector Megure ordered the other officers to search the surrounding area for a long time, but they found not the slightest trace.

They continued searching for another hour, but still found nothing.

"Damn it! Issue a nationwide manhunt order for Night Baron, and classify him as a major thief!" Inspector Megure shouted, his face ashen.

"A major thief? Is he the same type as Kaito Kid?" Takagi asked, confused.

"No. Kaito Kid only steals jewels. This Night Baron steals gold coins, and also coins from other countries. His actions are far more serious."

Sato Miwako remained silent to one side. She had another question: why had Night Baron removed her handcuffs in the end? Was it simply because he considered himself a gentleman?

At that moment, Heiji had long since gone. Indeed, he had used a rope to descend. As for why they couldn't find the rope or any sign of its use...

Very simple: the work of the system.

As long as no trace related to Heiji's crime was discovered within five seconds after a successful theft, the system would automatically help him erase all traces, as if he had never been at the scene.

Ding~~!!!

"Congratulations to the host for completing the rank C mission. Mission 'Steal the fifteen thousand Gold Maple Leaf coins' completed. Reward: Gliding Flight skill. Additionally, the coins are at the host's disposal."

The system's voice fell silent again. Then Heiji felt a change in his body, as if he could control the air currents around him.

Just ahead was a small hill. From there, it would take less than ten minutes to get to Ran's house.

Although it was a small hill, it was thirty to forty meters high. Looking at the scattered lights below, he felt a chill.

"To hell with it, go all out."

Heiji, carrying the four sacks of coins, leaped and launched himself into the void.

Fiuuu!!!

The wind whistled in his ears, his blood-red tailcoat billowed, and Heiji glided at full speed, like a bird.

To the left! To the right!

The ability seemed innate to him; he controlled it with no difficulty.

In the darkness, a blood-colored silhouette crossed in front of the full moon, mysterious and noble.

Heiji returned to the attic where the Maple Leaf gold coins were kept, but he didn't take them down. Leaving them up there still had great utility.

The night slowly fell.

Ring, ring, ring!~~

"Yes, speak. Tokyo Metropolitan Police Department, Criminal Investigation Division, this is Inspector Megure."

"Ah, it's you, young Kudo... What? Do you know where the fifteen thousand Maple Leaf gold coins are? Yes, yes, I understand. We're leaving immediately."

Inspector Megure jumped up, grabbed his gun, and put on his hat. "Takagi, Miwako, Chiba, we're leaving immediately! They've found the Maple Leaf gold coins!"

Bii~~ Bii~~ Bii~~

On the streets, more than a dozen police cars sped down the road. Upon hearing the loud sound of sirens, other vehicles moved out of the way.

In the attic, Conan looked grimly at the several large bags hanging above his head. Judging by the scattered gold coins, there was no doubt they were the Maple Leaf coins.

But...

[Who made the call?]

Conan pinched his chin, leaning against the wall, analyzing the situation: "It can't be a normal person. A normal person who wanted to report something wouldn't call a detective agency, they'd go directly to the police. And certainly not using Morse code. What is the purpose of that person? If they were a criminal, it would be impossible for them not to feel tempted upon finding these coins. What are they after?"

His mind was in chaos.

"Ah, ah, there are very few clues, I don't know where to start."

In some corner of the attic, Heiji sat silently. In the darkness, a faint light illuminated his face, giving him a strangely terrifying appearance.

Conan searched the entire attic, but found no clues, not even traces that anyone had been there.

"It seems no one has been here, but then, how did that person know the coins were here, and with such precision about their location? Could it be the leader of the thief group, Dino Cabana? Impossible, he was arrested yesterday. Aaaahhh!!!"

Conan fell into despair again. This was the first time he faced a case in which he felt so helpless, with not a single clue.

"Wait, why did that person call Uncle's agency? Were they looking for him? That doesn't make sense either, they didn't even confirm if it was him answering the phone before starting with the Morse code. Could it be...?"

Boom!

It was as if a lightning bolt struck his mind, and he almost lost his balance.

"Could it have been those two men in black?"

Conan's face turned pale with panic. If that was the case, then this encrypted map case was undoubtedly a deliberate test for him.

"They've discovered me! Then, is Ran in serious danger?"

He turned around and ran toward the stairs.

At that moment, the police sirens blared loudly outside. Before he could leave, he was intercepted by Inspector Megure and his team, who were rushing up.

"What is a child doing here?" asked Satou Miwako, surprised.

"I just came to play, I'm going home now."

Conan was dead with worry. In any case, the police already knew where the coins were; he had to go back to protect Ran.

"Inspector Megure, there are several bags hanging from the ceiling, they are very heavy!" shouted a policeman from the attic to Inspector Megure and the others.

"Don't worry about this kid now, let's go up and check."

Da, da, da!

Inspector Megure ran up to the attic with Satou Miwako and the others.

Conan sighed in relief and ran downstairs. As he ran, he heard a loud noise of something heavy falling in the attic. It was clear that Inspector Megure and his team had brought down the coins.

"Ran, please, don't let anything happen to you."

He screamed inwardly.

"Who's there?"

Suddenly, a loud shout from Inspector Megure was heard from the attic, followed by the headlights of all the police cars outside focusing on the attic window openings.

Conan, who had just reached the first floor, looked up. A figure was standing in the window opening. He stopped dead in his tracks, his pupils contracting sharply. "That's..."

A blood-red suit; not only the pants were that color, but also the vest and shirt underneath. His long tailcoat fluttered in the wind, and he wore a cloak over it, also blood red. Just by the clothing, it resembled that of a medieval Western vampire.

The most terrifying thing was the mask on his face, pale white but not unpleasant to the eye, which, combined with the blood-red tailcoat that gleamed faintly, gave off an aura of mystery and seductive charm.

If one had to describe the feeling...

A vampire, that mysterious creature capable of seducing countless young and mature women.

This mysterious masked man was, of course, Heiji. The system required him to take the fifteen thousand Maple Leaf gold coins right under the noses of the police, so naturally, he couldn't appear with his true face.

As he passed by that store and saw that tailcoat, he instantly had an idea: to do like Kaito Kid and appear with a different identity. That way, he would avoid a lot of trouble.

"When sin calls me, I appear. And then, I will take from their hands what belongs to me, what I have baptized as 'Sin.'"

Heiji slightly altered his tone of voice. Although it wasn't a full change of voice, it was impossible to recognize his original timbre. Moreover, his way of speaking had also changed; even Kazuha wouldn't recognize him.

"'What belongs to him'? Could it be...?" A sharp gleam crossed Conan's eyes, and he ran back to the attic.

"I am Inspector Megure from the Tokyo Metropolitan Police. I suspect you are involved with the Italian thief group, and I must take you in for questioning," said Inspector Megure seriously to Heiji.

"Raise your hands, don't resist."

Satou, with her long legs covered by high stockings, approached, taking out the handcuffs to arrest Heiji.

"It's an honor to serve such a beautiful officer."

Heiji gave Satou a standard aristocratic bow. His elegant gesture and his noble, mysterious aura made Satou's heart flutter slightly.

Taking a soft breath, Satou regained her usual expression and stood before Heiji, looking up at him. "Lower."

Heiji extended his hands and jumped from the window opening. "Mmm~ a delicate and elegant fragrance. This young officer is like a flower bud, waiting for the day of its blooming. I wonder if I will have the honor of being the first, and the last, to pluck that flower."

Satou's energetic face blushed slightly. This guy dared to flirt with her in front of so many people.

"Extend your hands."

Her voice became cold suddenly; she couldn't afford to make a fool of herself in front of the other officers.

Heiji smiled elegantly, and his blood-colored gloved hands slowly closed into fists, lowering them.

In a cafe!

"Kazuha, Ran, stay here and have something to eat. Something just came up, and I have to step out for a moment," Heiji said, waving goodbye to the two girls before quickly disappearing into the crowd.

"You're lucky, Kazuha. I'm sure Heiji went to buy you the scarf you liked," Ran said enviously.

"Ah, no way! I'm sure something else came up for Heiji."

Though she denied it outwardly, Kazuha's heart was filled with anticipation.

Heiji returned to the mall, but at that moment, he was no longer the same. He had put on a light disguise, one that didn't raise suspicion but was easy to forget.

In short, he was like an extremely ordinary passerby, easy to overlook.

"Welcome!"

Upon seeing Heiji enter, the shop assistant bowed very politely.

"How much is this suit?"

Heiji pointed to a very common red suit hanging on a rack. Both the pants and jacket, and even the shirt, were a dark red, like the color of blood, slightly gleaming under the light.

"You have a good eye, sir. Although this style is quite common, it's very popular, so the price has remained high. It costs 120,000 yen," the assistant explained patiently.

Heiji pretended to lower his head to think, looked at other models, and in the end, bought the red suit.

"Thank you very much for your purchase."

As he left the store, Heiji's expression immediately returned to normal. He was sure that if he went back in, the shop assistant wouldn't recognize him.

Disguising oneself was a skill every mechanic had to master, and master perfectly.

If you disguise yourself as an old man, you must be an old man;

if you disguise yourself as a knight, you must be a knight.

If you want to be remembered, you must be the most dazzling light among the crowd;

if you want to be forgotten, you must be a speck of dust among the crowd.

Only then can you come and go without a trace, escaping the clutches of justice.

"Now, to buy a cloak of the same color."

Heiji was out for over two hours. Kazuha and Ran had already ordered several milk teas.

"Excuse me, who is Miss Toyama Kazuha?" suddenly asked a Starbucks employee.

"Ah, that's me. What's the matter?" Kazuha stood up and asked, puzzled.

"A call from Mr. Hattori," the employee smiled at Kazuha.

"Heiji?" Kazuha hurriedly grabbed the phone. "Heiji, where are you? I was so worried."

"I'm sorry, I might be a little late. Kazuha, you go back first with Ran."

"Okay, be careful and come back soon for dinner," Kazuha said, worried.

"Got it, I'll hang up now."

After hanging up, Heiji turned and left the phone booth.

[I remember those fifteen thousand Hoja de Arce gold coins appeared in "The Case of the Secret Map of the Metropolitan Highway." And the place where the treasure is hidden...]

Heiji looked up at a multi-story building: "It's here."

On the top floor, through the windowless gaps, he could easily see the large river and the bridge in the distance. He left his things and, when looking up, saw several large bags hanging and some gold coins scattered on the floor.

Indeed, they were the Hoja de Arce gold coins stolen from the Italian bank.

"Ah, a hundred million. Damn it, what a fraudulent system."

Heiji was very annoyed. If it weren't for the mission's restrictions, he could have taken the coins, worth a hundred million, directly. However, the system's mission requirement was to take them right under the nose of the police.

But he didn't complain too much.

Compared to the hundred million in coins, the Sliding Flight ability was the real jackpot.

He had already found the loot. Now it was time to make the plan.

[The plan is divided into two parts. The first is how to attract the police here; and the second is how to escape.]

Heiji lowered his head to think for a moment, and a mischievous smile appeared on his lips.

Mouri Detective Agency!

Conan was sitting on the couch, reading a boring book, while complaining to himself: "That girl, Ran, goes shopping and doesn't take me." And that bastard Hattori, damn it, when I return to my normal size, he'll see.

Ring, ring, ring!~~

"Uncle, there's a call."

However, all that could be heard were snoring sounds like thunder.

Looking at Mouri Kogoro, who had fallen asleep drunk at the desk, Conan couldn't help but smile bitterly. He approached and picked up the phone: "Yes, Mouri Detective Agency."

Knock, knock... knock...

"Hello? Hello?" Conan frowned, thinking it was a prank.

However, no one spoke on the other end. Only knocks could be heard on the receiver, very firm but intermittent, sometimes long, sometimes short.

"No, this is... Morse code."

Conan suddenly realized, horrified, and focused even more on listening to the sound.

"...knock knock knock... knock knock... knock knock knock knock..."

"The Hoja de Arce gold coins are hidden in the encrypted map. What, the Hoja de Arce gold coins?" Conan's face changed drastically. "Hey, who is this? Who are you?"

Tuuu~~

However, the person on the other end hung up directly.

"Damn it! Where's the encrypted map?" Conan hung up the phone, furious.

"And now, breaking news. Countless pieces of paper are falling from the Tokyo Tower. These papers are covered with various symbols. For now, it is suspected to be a prank."

The TV image stopped on one of the papers, which was covered with various drawings.

"This is... No, this isn't a prank," Conan's expression suddenly changed. "This is the encrypted map the call was talking about!"

A loud bang woke up Mouri Kogoro, who looked at the agency with bleary eyes from alcohol before falling back asleep.

"Done. That guy, Conan, should solve it soon. Now, I just need to prepare the escape route."

Heiji hung up the phone, with a relaxed expression. As an elite mechanic, how could he not know Morse code? And furthermore, it was at the most basic level.

If Conan didn't understand such a code, he really wouldn't be worthy of the title of great detective.
